faqs.question: Is BCom available at IIMT University Meerut?
faqs.answer: IIMT University offers a full-time BCom (Hons) amg other UG-level courses. The three-year course is divided into six semesters. faqs.question: How are IIMT University placements for BCom students?
faqs.answer: The official IIMT University BCom placements report has not yet been released by the university. However, some insights into the university's BCom placements are available in the IIMT University reviews on Shiksha.com. As per a recent review provided by a BCom student, the lowest and the highest salary packages offered during recent placements were INR 6 LPA and INR 20 LPA, respectively. With the top recruitment companies, such as Amazon, Wipro, Infosys, Oyo, etc., the university recorded a good placement percentage.

faqs.question: How can I apply for BCom admission at IIMT University?
faqs.answer:
IIMT University BCom application process can be completed in one of the three ways. The institute accepts online as well as offline applications. A registration fee of INR 2,000 (non-refundable) must be paid while applying. More details about the application process are as follows:
Online Application: Candidates can visit the university's official website to apply. New user must first register with basic details and verify their contact information. 
Offline Application: Candidates can obtain the application form from the university campus and submit it at the reception. Alternatively, they can download the application form from the official website and send it to the below-given address (along with a bank draft or proof of payment for the registration fee):
To,  
The Admission Section
IIMT University,
'O' Pocket, Ganga Nagar,
Meerut – 250001

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: College life is a sweet journey.

review_content.Placements: Some teach, non-tech, medical companies come for placements, but only 30% students got the placements, not every student. The average package is 3 LPA, and the highest package is 16 LPA. Many tech and non-tech companies visit for internships, which provide a 3 to 6-month internship. But they selected students through an interview for the internship, so only those students who qualify will do the internship.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has its own gym and cafeteria, which are open from 8 am to 9 pm. The last time to go to the hostel is 8 pm, and if you are on campus for the day school then the last time is 6 pm. There are many cafes near the college to visit. Our college provides Wi-Fi and everything that is useful for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the course and college as well. Placement, infrastructure, and facility are best.

review_content.Placements: 65 percent of students are placed on campus. The highest package is 33.5 LPA, and the lowest is 3LPA. Infosys and HCL recruit. 40 percent of students cracked internships in Infosys and in other small startups funded by the college itself. Full-stack developer, software engineer, and management are roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good, with properly functioning labs, Wi-Fi, a library, and classrooms. The hostel facilities are good, the mess is perfect with proper sports and medical facilities.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are skilled and experienced, and teaching quality is best with proper explanation and detailed notes. The course is relevant and focuses on making students ready for the industry and modern technology. Semesters are quite easy with a 90 percent passing percentage.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, the university is good and provides a good environment for students

review_content.Placements: Around 70 to 75 percent of students get placed. All these are posted through campus placement drive. This year, many new top recruiting companies came to campus, such as Mahindra. Internship ratio is 100 percent, all students get internship from the college placement cell. Top roles are HR, developer, and data analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, the university provides a core environment and the latest designed syllabus. Wi-Fi quality is a little not good. Labs have the best desktops and the latest OS version. Classes are equipped with digital boards and whiteboards. The library system is very impressive; timings are from 8 am to 8 pm. Hostel provides 5-time meals and laundry service. Rooms are fully furnished. Mess provides average quality, and canteens are best. IIMT provides free doctor consultation in IIMT hospital. All sports coaches are present in the evening for their respective sports practice.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Physics, Statistics, Mathematics) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The college is better than I expected.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 90% of students get placed according to their course. The highest package is 25 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tech Mahindra, Genpact, TravelPlus, Paytm, Unacademy, and others. Around 90% of students get internships in companies like Hirrey Limited, Genpact, and others.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi and a library where all types of books and newspapers are available. Our classrooms are very clean, and there is a smart TV on which we learn more clearly and do practicals in labs. Our canteen is very clean and spacious. The college has its own hospital. For sports, it has a cricket ground, volleyball court, basketball court, tennis court, and swimming pool.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: A good college for making a future in a particular field.

review_content.Placements: About 4 to 5 companies come for placement in the college. Only 10% students get placements from the college. Top recruitment companies are TCS, Jaro Education, and Hireyy. Hike education roles offered are Sales executive, business assistant executive and related to sales.
review_content.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful. All teachers are PhD qualified and knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is also good, yes, because commerce students can easily relate to all subjects in this course, and this subject also gives knowledge to students. The faculty of our department is good, but some are not. But all the faculty members of our department are PhD, no teacher can be appointed without Ph.D. degree, and the behaviour of the teachers is also good, the teaching methods are also good, and experienced teachers are appointed.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Physiotherapy - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am quite satisfied because faculty is very friendly, clear-sighted, and they are totally worth it.

review_content.Placements: It was an allied health and science course so package was not decided basically. You had to do an internship before getting a job after completing. In this course, your skills and knowledge about therapy matter to get a job in top hospital. Physiotherapist and intern were the top roles offered in this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: In IIMT University facilities like labs, classroom, and library were totally fine. All the important books were available and issued from the library at free of cost. Classrooms were big and labs had all the working equipments. The quality of food in hostel and mess was really great. You could participate in every game at this university, no matter which course you were pursuing.

The average package is 3 LPA, and the highest package is 16 LPA. Many tech and non-tech companies visit for internships, which provide a 3 to 6-month internship. But they selected students through an interview for the internship, so only those students who qualify will do the internship.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has its own gym and cafeteria, which are open from 8 am to 9 pm. The last time to go to the hostel is 8 pm, and if you are on campus for the day school then the last time is 6 pm. There are many cafes near the college to visit. Our college provides Wi-Fi and everything that is useful for students.

individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the course and college as well. Placement, infrastructure, and facility are best.

content.Placements: 65 percent of students are placed on campus. The highest package is 33.5 LPA, and the lowest is 3LPA. Full-stack developer, software engineer, and management are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good, with properly functioning labs, Wi-Fi, a library, and classrooms. The hostel facilities are good, the mess is perfect with proper sports and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the university is good and provides a good environment for students

content.Placements: Around 70 to 75 percent of students get placed. All these are posted through campus placement drive. This year, many new top recruiting companies came to campus, such as Mahindra. content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, the university provides a core environment and the latest designed syllabus. Wi-Fi quality is a little not good. individual_reviews.title: The college is better than I expected.

content.Placements: Approximately 90% of students get placed according to their course. The highest package is 25 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. paragraphs: IIMT University Meerut admissionis ongoing for all courses. Interested candidates can apply online or offline to their desired course. TheIIMTU Meerut admission criteriaare entrance-based for all programmes. After the submission of the application form, eligible candidates are called for the personal interview round and then the assessment test.IIMT Universityalso considersCUET scoresto shortlist candidates for admission. Interested students can read the following article to know all about the programmes, eligibility and selection criteria, and admission process for IIMT University.

IIMT University offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral-level courses in various areas of study such as Agriculture,Arts, Commerce, Management,Engineering, etc. The courses are offered throughIIMTU constituent schools and colleges.

IIMT University course admissionis primarily entrance-based. Candidates seeking admission toIIMTU coursesmust meet the eligibility criteria before filling out the application form. Candidates can eitherappear for CUET or university-level selection roundsto secure admission at IIMTU Meerut. However, all aspirants must meet the eligibility criteria. Interested candidates can check out the table below forIIMT University eligibility and selection criteriafor some popular courses:

IIMTU admission processbegins with the release of the application form and brochure. Candidates willing to secure admission at IIMT University can apply online or offline. The admission criteria forIIMT University coursesare completely entrance-based. Candidates can either undergo the university-level selection rounds or meet theIIMT University CUET eligibility criteriaand appear for the same.
The step-wiseIIMT University admission processis given below:
Step 1: IIMT University Registration Process

TheIIMTU application processis conducted in bothonline and offline modes. To apply online, candidates are required to visit the official website of the University,https://iimtu.edu.in/,and fill out the application form. Candidates willing to apply offline can do so by visiting theIIMT University campus in Meerut.
Step 2: IIMT University Selection Process

The admission criteria for all courses are entrance-based. Candidates are shortlisted based on assessment tests and personal interviews conducted by the University. Apart from assessment andPI, IIMT University also acceptsCUET scores.
Step 3: IIMT University Final Admission
Selected candidates will be issued an admission letter. To secure their admission, candidates are required to appear for the document verification process and pay the admission fee.

paragraphs: The admission process ofSymbiosis Institute of Business Management Bangaloreis mainly online. Candidates have to go through a multi-step admission process, which includes filling out the application form, qualifying for the exam and release of the merit list. Find below the detailed steps for theSIBM Bengaluru admission process:
STEP 1: SIBM Bangalore Application Process

SIBM Bangalore applications are conducted in an online mode. Candidates must register for SNAP (Symbiosis National Aptitude Test) and appear for the exam. Once the exam results are out, students need to register on the official website of the institute and fill out the application form available.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

SIBM Bangalore admissions are entirely entrance-based for MBA. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective courses. The institute conducts accepts SNAP scores for admission to MBA courses. Further, students must also appear for Group Exercises and Persona Interview rounds for the final selection. Whereas for E-MBA, admission is granted based on a PI round.
STEP 3: Merit List Release
After the commencement of all selection rounds, the institute releases a merit list of the selected candidates on its official website.
Candidates whose names appeared in the merit list will have to pay a certain amount of course fee to lock their seats.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for MBA students.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Bengaluru is a hill paradise. The campus is really a paradise, surrounded by greenery, and it feels like natural beauty. Many Bollywood movies are shot at SIBM Bengaluru. The hostel is also nice. There are double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms with attached washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: SIBM Bangalore: Fantastic Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is fantastic. The teaching with advanced equipment and technology is very good. All necessary equipment is available for the practical learning of students. Libraries and classrooms are fully air-conditioned. Proper facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college needs improvement in teaching skills.
reviews.review_text: Food quality was okay, and sports facilities were there with multiple options. Many students come at the same time for tennis for which the space was limited. If coordinated well everyone can enjoy some sports, else there will be a lot of chaos.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for MBA students where students can gain knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Students are MBA, so they didn't have any laboratory. The library is excellent and classrooms having digital board, and Wi-Fi is also available 24X7. The hostel is very good like 3-star hotel-type rooms, and food is very good, taste, and of good quality. Sports are also provided in this college.

reviews.review_heading: There are good placements because of the location.
reviews.review_text: There is a free Wi-Fi facility on our campus, along with very good infrastructure. There are also Bloomberg labs, and only some of the colleges are able to provide these opportunities. Hostel and mess facilities are also great. Proper medical care is also provided to students on the campus only.

reviews.review_heading: Smooth learning experience so far, though virtually.
reviews.review_text:
Faculty members are highly qualified and most of them have a healthy number of corporate experience as well. Infrastructure includes, common rooms, sports activities, gym, Wi-Fi enabled rooms, library, mess. 
 Best possible arrangements are there. All the medical facilities are there within campus only. Mess and canteen food is great too.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely in love with the college, faculties and course, Would totally recommend it to everyone !
reviews.review_text: Dedicated bloomberg lab, curriculum following harvard business school, wi-fi enabled campus and labs, digital library and portal, air conditioned labs and classrooms. Sharing rooms with separate study tables and cupboards, water dispensaries available at every floor, hostel mess got a variety of food to choose from, separate area for indoor and outdoor games and a separate healthcare committee.

reviews.review_heading: What makes SIBM Bengaluru stand out.
reviews.review_text: SIBM - Bengaluru has various facilities like a well-equipped gym, basketball court, badminton court, and other recreational and fitness oriented arenas. We have Yoga and mental health sessions, to keep the positivity around. Wi-Fi, library, separate reading rooms, TV rooms are also provided to students. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, and are neatly maintained. Food is served four times a day. Adequate medical facility is also provided, for those in need. For further questions, you are ...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with SIBM.
reviews.review_text: The campus is not that huge, but it is well-maintained with gym, library, etc. Campus life is great. It is strategically located in the IT hub of Bengaluru, and it offers great opportunities. The cafeteria is good, and the food quality is not compromised at any cost. Everything is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Great Placements for 2018-20 Batch despite economic slowdown.
reviews.review_text:
SIBM Bengaluru has Bloomberg Lab, well-equipped Library, Students also has access to library. Internet Connections and Wi-Fi access is provided to each student Hence they are connected both in campus and Hostel
There is 2 sharing and 3 sharing rooms available in hostel, Lift access is there for the 8 storeyed Hostel. There are staff who regularly clean your rooms. Mess offers both veg and non veg meals. Breakfast, Lunch High Tea and Dinner is provided in the mess. Nonveg is provided 4 times in a...

reviews.review_heading: Worth the money, experienced faculty, curriculum providing hands on experience, decent placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available for students 24x7. Also the library facility is available which has the collection of all the latest books and e-books. Computer labs are available for usage along with the availability of Bloomberg terminal. Mess is open all the 7 days which serves hot and fresh food 4 times a day, that is breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner. A doctor is available in the campus 24x7. The sports facilities are very good as various inter college tournaments are organised round the year.

reviews.review_heading: Home Away from Home. This college has something which makes you the best version of yourself.

Located in the lush green environs of Electronic City, the imposing structure of SIBM Bengaluru stands tall amidst the sprawling campuses of global IT giants. The institute boasts of state-of-the-art infrastructure with the following amenities
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- well-equipped classrooms
- Library

- Ultramodern Gymnasium

reviews.review_heading: Great crowd, Delight to be part of the college.
reviews.review_text: Small in compare to other b-schools yet it has a decent infrastructure. Its main attractions are bloomberg lab, library, auditorium, indoor sports complex, Wi-Fi etc. Which is available for the students. Hostel room can occupy upto 250 students. Quality of food is decent in compare to others.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers a great environment and learning experience.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Bengaluru has a good infrastructure with all the necessary facilities required for the students. Six Bloomberg terminals, computer labs, library, indoor sports complex, and Wi-Fi facility are some of its attraction. There is a separate hostel for girls and boys. Quality of food served in the mess and canteen is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers a great environment. Teachers are the best here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent but quite small when compared to the other B-schools. Location is a certain disadvantage for college. Facilities like Bloomberg lab, computer lab, library, auditorium, Wi-Fi, all are available for the students on a regular basis. Hostel rooms are comfortable and spacious.

placements.overview:
Assam Down Town University (ADTU) was established in 2010 by the down town Charity Trust. ADTU has more than 4000 students and over 300 faculty. Down Town University Guwahati courses are given in the disciplines in Engineering, Allied Health Science, Management, Nursing, and Pharmacy. Assam Down Town University (ADTU) is home to both Indian and international students. ADTU Guwahati has been accredited by NAAC with an 'A+' grade.

Down Town University in Guwahati provides students with a vast amount of exposure in several forms- modern teaching methods, global links for research, student exchange and knowledge sharing, world-class infrastructure, placement, diversity of students, and industry-institute interaction. ADTU has collaborated with Rotary Club of Guwahati, North East Cancer Hospital and Research Institute, Indian Institute of Technology, and many more in the field of science.

ADTU has multiple course options for students from different streams and fields. Assam Down Town University Panikhaiti Guwahati courses include popular Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Bachelor of Technology (BTech) programmes. UG and PG courses are offered at ADTU Guwahati. In UG programmes, other courses include BSc, BDes, BBA, etc., while PG options are MSc, MSW, MPharma, etc.

faqs.question: On what basis are Assam Downtown University MBA seats allocated?

faqs.answer: A:    Admission to the MBA programme in dual specialisations are currently ongoing at Assam Down Town University (ADTU). Firstly, a candidate has to clear the general eligibility criteria of scoring 50 percent in graduation. Also, you can opt to take the ADTU CST (Common Scholarship Test). Alternatively, ADTU also welcomes candidates based on their undergraduate performance, a good CGPA or Merit scores obtained.

review_content.Placements: I am in B.Tech CSE, I had 62 percent in my 12th and chose ADTU to study CSE with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The one campus placement offers are not that good, but not bad either. If you maintain a good GPA, then the chances of getting a good placement are higher, ranging from 3.3 LPA to 11 LPA sometimes.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in every aspect. ADTU has Wi-Fi connection all around the campus and per classroom, smart boards and projectors per class, a library is big, has a gym, swimming pool, badminton court, football ground, and everything. The hostel facility is good too, they have a geyser, washing machines, and a dryer. You can get an AC facility in the hostel.

faqs.answer: A:    CAT cutoffs are usually not announced with the CAT result. The CAT cutoffs are also not released to the public.They are published after a few days of the result announcement when the IIMs and other colleges start their shortlisting process. The IIMs opens their shortlisting window based on the CAT cut-offs two to three days after the result announcement. The CAT percentile of candidates shortlisted for the Written Ability Test (WAT), Group Discussion (GD), and Personal Interview (PI) can be considered the cut-off for that IIM. For example, if a candidate with a CAT percentile of 99 belonging to the General category is selected for the WAT/GD-PI of IIM Calcutta, then the CAT cut-off for IIM Calcutta is 99 percentile. Only those candidates who make it to the WAT/GD-PI round of IIMs will get to know the cut-offs.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: They give placement, good faculty, they help, so you can go for it.

review_content.Placements: Not much student percentage are placed, but this year in BBA, 200 plus companies have come for interviews. If you failed, they will train you on how to sit in interviews. The highest is 8 LPA in BBA, the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies include Bajaj Finance, Agile, etc. There are more. Around 80 percent placements in BBA, B. Tech, PGDM, BCA, MBA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. Lifts are there, AC in almost every class. Teachers are also good at teaching. Labs are okay, library they have made quite good. Hostel rooms were good, food was average. Sports not happens much, games are less, only in first year happens.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Only for management students.

review_content.Placements: GNIOT placement is average, according to me. The average package is 2 LPA-4 LPA, and the highest package is 12 LPA. The main thing is that recruiters do not come from the big companies. The company that comes for placement is small, and almost all the students get the internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good and fully air-conditioned but the internet connectivity is too poor. There is a separate library and lab for each department. The college grounds are not too big but they are decent and the cafeteria is also good with a reasonable price.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: GNIOT offers a good campus, supportive faculty, and average placement opportunities.

review_content.Placements: GNIOT has an active placement cell that invites many companies yearly. In recent drives, over 300-400 recruiters visited, with around 700+ students placed across programs. The highest salary has gone up to around 70 LPA (international) and domestic packages around 27 LPA, while the average package is around 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HP, Cognizant, and many more, offering roles in IT, management, finance, and analytics.
review_content.Infrastructure: GNIOT has a large, modern campus with AC classrooms, smart boards, labs for all departments, and a big library with thousands of books and e-resources. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, sports grounds, an auditorium, cafeteria, medical facilities, Wi-Fi, and transport services. Overall, good infrastructure for study and campus life.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Let's talk about GNIOT Greater Noida.

review_content.Placements: College history on a placement basis is not that great, placements are just average. Almost 80% students are placed, but all those are mass recruitment companies taking students on packages of 3-5 LPA. For placements, you have to work hard and try on your own if you need better.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college area is not that vast, but the infrastructure is good. Classes are equipped with AC and smart projectors. Hostel facility is also available. Three canteens are in the college. Sports facilities are also available in the college. The college is also equipped with a music room. Which is in gips.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: The GNIOT College, the only way to success for you.

review_content.Placements: The passing out batch has got a very great placement in various companies with a good package. The average package is around 600,000-700,000. Companies like Zomato, Tata, and Boast come to campus. The college even provides internships and hackathons with great prize money.
review_content.Infrastructure: Talking honestly, it is not worth it. The building is old, the food is not tasty, the Wi-Fi network is poor, and the hostel timings are very strict. The price is quite high. You can get non-campus hostels or PGs at a cheaper rate with more facilities and fewer rules and regulations.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Greater Noida Institute of Technology.

review_content.Placements: Usually, there is no discussion about the placement ratio. Teachers just informed us that most of students did not get any placement due to a lack of skills and knowledge. Most of them get rejected in companies' aptitude tests, but the college mentioned on their website that the highest package offered is 70 LPA. The average package offered is 7.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: According to me, the infrastructure is okay. Wi-Fi is good and has a speed of more than 100 Mbps. Every class has its own Wi-Fi network. The institution also has a particular Wi-Fi. The library is good, but they don't have as many books as they mentioned on the website. However, it can be managed. Hostel food is average according to my friends and me.

review_summary.college_name: GNIOT Greater Noida Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: They give placement, good faculty, they help, so you can go for it.

content.Placements: Not much student percentage are placed, but this year in BBA, 200 plus companies have come for interviews. If you failed, they will train you on how to sit in interviews. The highest is 8 LPA in BBA, the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies include Bajaj Finance, Agile, etc. There are more. Around 80 percent placements in BBA, B. Tech, PGDM, BCA, MBA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. Lifts are there, AC in almost every class. Teachers are also good at teaching. Labs are okay, library they have made quite good. Hostel rooms were good, food was average. Sports not happens much, games are less, only in first year happens.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Only for management students.

content.Placements: GNIOT placement is average, according to me. The average package is 2 LPA-4 LPA, and the highest package is 12 LPA. The main thing is that recruiters do not come from the big companies. The company that comes for placement is small, and almost all the students get the internships.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good and fully air-conditioned but the internet connectivity is too poor. There is a separate library and lab for each department. The college grounds are not too big but they are decent and the cafeteria is also good with a reasonable price.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: GNIOT offers a good campus, supportive faculty, and average placement opportunities.

content.Placements: GNIOT has an active placement cell that invites many companies yearly. In recent drives, over 300-400 recruiters visited, with around 700+ students placed across programs. The highest salary has gone up to around 70 LPA (international) and domestic packages around 27 LPA, while the average package is around 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HP, Cognizant, and many more, offering roles in IT, management, finance, and analytics.
content.Infrastructure: GNIOT has a large, modern campus with AC classrooms, smart boards, labs for all departments, and a big library with thousands of books and e-resources. There are separate hostels for boys and girls, sports grounds, an auditorium, cafeteria, medical facilities, Wi-Fi, and transport services. Overall, good infrastructure for study and campus life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Let's talk about GNIOT Greater Noida.

content.Placements: College history on a placement basis is not that great, placements are just average. Almost 80% students are placed, but all those are mass recruitment companies taking students on packages of 3-5 LPA. For placements, you have to work hard and try on your own if you need better.
content.Infrastructure: The college area is not that vast, but the infrastructure is good. Classes are equipped with AC and smart projectors. Hostel facility is also available. Three canteens are in the college. Sports facilities are also available in the college. The college is also equipped with a music room. Which is in gips.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The GNIOT College, the only way to success for you.

content.Placements: The passing out batch has got a very great placement in various companies with a good package. The average package is around 600,000-700,000. Companies like Zomato, Tata, and Boast come to campus. The college even provides internships and hackathons with great prize money.
content.Infrastructure: Talking honestly, it is not worth it. The building is old, the food is not tasty, the Wi-Fi network is poor, and the hostel timings are very strict. The price is quite high. You can get non-campus hostels or PGs at a cheaper rate with more facilities and fewer rules and regulations.

admission_overview.college_name: GNIOT Greater Noida Course Admissions 2025: Fees, Eligibility, Dates & Selection Process

paragraphs: GNIOT Greater Noidaadmissions 2025 are open. GNIOT offers popular courses in the field of Technical and Management courses. It is approved by AICTE, the Ministry of HRD, Government of India. Also, it is affiliated withDr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. Candidates can also choose courses in streams like Computer Applications, Science, Commerce, etc.GNIOTGreater Noida conducts admission on the basis of both merit and entrance exam scores. The popularly accepted entrance exams are CAT, MAT, CMAT, JEE Main, CUET UG, etc. The final seat allotment is done based on UPTAC Counselling process. Candidates can get in touch with the admission department and seek further procedures for admission in 2025. Read on the following article to know more about GNIOT course admission 2025.

GNIOT Greater Noida admission is carried out based on the basic eligibility criteria and scores of various national-level entrance exams for respective courses. Candidates can check the GNIOT popular courses in the table below:
UG degree with 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ST)
CAT/MAT/CMAT/NMAT/XAT+ GAT+ GD & PI

Merit-based + UPTAC Counselling

Note:This information is taken from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

GNIOT course admission to UG & PG programmes is both merit and entrance-based. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria to get admission to various courses. GNIOT admission process consists of various steps. Find below the complete details aboutGNIOT course admissions 2025:
Step 1: GNIOT Application Form

Candidates seeking admission to PGDM course at GNIOT must fill an online application form in either online or offline mode. Along with that, candidates have to pay an application fee ofINR 1,200either through credit card, debit card or net banking.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

GNIOT course admissions such as BBA, BCA, MCA, etc are based on academic records of the previous qualifying exam, followed by UPTAC counselling. Furthermore, for admission to the BTech course, candidates either need to qualify for the JEE Main/ CUET UG or GNIOT Online Test.

Similarly, GNIOT Noida admission for PGDM courses is entirely entrance-based. Eligible candidates are selected based on scores of either CMAT/ CAT/XAT/MAT/GMAT and GIMS Aptitude Test (GAT). The final selection is based on the performance of candidates in Group Discussions and Personal Interview rounds. GIMS admission panel as appointed by the director for the particular academic year. The shortlisting of the application forms shall be done based on following parameters primarily:1. Consistency of academic record.2. Versatility of academic records.3. Relevant work experience for the programme (if any).
Step 3: Final Admission
After the selection round, shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Candidates must pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.answer: A:    No, you cannot get into the MBA programme at Centurion University of Technology and Management (CUTM), Bhubaneswar Campus, with an 88% score in OJEE (Odisha Joint Entrance Examination). Here's why:OJEE is primarily for engineering admissions: OJEE is meant for selecting students for B.Tech and M.Tech programs in engineering disciplines in Odisha. CUTM's MBA programme is a separate programme with its own admission criteria and entrance exams.CUTM MBA doesn't accept OJEE scores: CUET-PG (Centurion University Entrance Test) and CAT (Common Admission Test) are the primary entrance exams accepted for CUTM's MBA program. OJEE scores are not considered in the selection process.Therefore, having an 88% in OJEE will not be helpful for your application to the CUTM MBA program.

review_summary.college_name: Centurion University Bhubaneswar Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Centurion University review.

content.Placements: The placement in our course was the best among all courses. The placement percentage was around 85–90 percent. The highest package was also secured by our course only, i.e., 22 LPA. The average package was around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: You will enjoy the college.

content.Placements: Only a few students were placed, nearly 35% students in our course. Minimum package is 3 LPA, and the highest I don't have any valid proof because college says nearly 24, but we don't believe. Wipro, Amazon, and TCS recruit. More of them were placed in Wipro or TCS. Software engineer and supervisor roles were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, and I recommend you visit it as there are lots of places like the butterfly garden, gram tarang, etc. Wi-Fi is here, but don't rely on it as they have less network speed. The library is here, but it doesn't have new books, all are old. The hostel is very bad, I heard it, but I don't know that much because I am a day scholar.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Also a very good college.

content.Placements: In our college, a minimum of 70% students are placed in our course. The lowest package of the last year is 3 LPA, and the highest package is 10 LPA. Many top recruiting companies come, like IBM, and an old senior of our college is placed at Google.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is the best. There are many types in our college. A big ground, a volleyball court, a gym area, and a swimming pool are available in the college. The classroom is completely AC and very spacious.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very satisfied with the college. Infrastructure, facilities, faculty members, and all are good.

content.Placements: 80 to 85% students were placed. The highest package is 6 to 7 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiters are Tata, Godrej, Alphabets, HAL, etc. Every Student needs to do internship, which is also provided by the college. College will provide its own internship programme. Service Engineer, Designer, Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Every possible facility is available in the college as well as the hostel. Food is good, Wi-Fi was available, and the Lab was also very useful. They also have an option available of AC luxury in a hostel that was value for money. I also chose the luxury one, and all the facilities were good.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Master of Science (M.Sc.) + Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is recognized as one of the best skill institutions in Odisha.

content.Placements: Placement opportunities at the college are impressive. Starting from the second year, students participate in internships at various hospitals. Many graduates are recruited by these same hospitals based on their performance, and there are also opportunities to secure positions at renowned institutions such as AIIMS.
content.Infrastructure: College is set in a peaceful and green environment, making it a pleasant place to study. The hostels are well-maintained, with spacious rooms and all necessary facilities provided. Hostel wardens are also very cooperative and ensure students feel comfortable.

admission_process.title: Centurion University of Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Centurion University of Technology and Management (CUTM) Bhubaneswar, offers UG, PG and Diploma courses with a diverse range of over 100 courses across various fields, includingEngineering, Management,Science, Mass Communication and Media,Design, Hotel Management, and Pharmacy. ForCenturion University Bhubaneswaradmissions, candidates are required to appear for the CUEE which is conducted by the University. Admission to courses offered in the field of Management, Technology, Science and Engineering requires a valid score in CUEE.

Centurion University Bhubaneswar coursesoffer a range of diploma, UG, PG, research-level and certificate programmes offered through multiple departments working under it. Some of the popular courses offered at Centurion University Bhubaneswar are mentioned in below table along with their eligibility criteria:
Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) with 50% aggregate (5% relaxation for reserved category)
BSc in respective disciplines
Bachelor's degree
Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Maths/Biology) with 45% aggregate
CUEE BPharm

Step 1: ApplicationTheprocess ofadmissionat Centurion University of Technology and Managementstartswiththe online application formsubmittedonitsofficialwebsiteby the aspirant.Inadditiontotheapplication,thefeewouldbeleviedaspertheprogrammechosen.However,inadditiontothat, the candidate is supposedto upload scanned copies of documentsincludingacademic transcripts, mark sheets, certificates, and a passport-sizephotograph.

Step 2: Entrance ExamSome of the programmes at the university have entrance examination of their own, referred to as CUEE. On the other hand, some of the university takes specific scores from national level exams like JEE Main, SAT, or even any other national level exam for entrance purpose. Candidates can choose between appearing in CUEE or submitting their scorecard for national level exam; however, this depends upon the rules followed by the program.

Step 3: Selection and CounsellingAfter the application and entrance exam (if applicable), candidates are shortlisted based on their scores. Those who are shortlisted will then be called for counseling, after which they can choose their program depending on merit and seat availability. To confirm their seat, candidates must accept the seat offered to them and pay the admission fee. After seat acceptance, original documents must be submitted for verification to complete the admission process.

reviews.review_heading: Centurion University review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

reviews.review_heading: You will enjoy the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, and I recommend you visit it as there are lots of places like the butterfly garden, gram tarang, etc. Wi-Fi is here, but don't rely on it as they have less network speed. The library is here, but it doesn't have new books, all are old. The hostel is very bad, I heard it, but I don't know that much because I am a day scholar.

reviews.review_heading: Also a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is the best. There are many types in our college. A big ground, a volleyball court, a gym area, and a swimming pool are available in the college. The classroom is completely AC and very spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the college. Infrastructure, facilities, faculty members, and all are good.
reviews.review_text: Every possible facility is available in the college as well as the hostel. Food is good, Wi-Fi was available, and the Lab was also very useful. They also have an option available of AC luxury in a hostel that was value for money. I also chose the luxury one, and all the facilities were good.

reviews.review_heading: College is recognized as one of the best skill institutions in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: College is set in a peaceful and green environment, making it a pleasant place to study. The hostels are well-maintained, with spacious rooms and all necessary facilities provided. Hostel wardens are also very cooperative and ensure students feel comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and better jobs are provided by our college.
reviews.review_text: Our department boasted well-equipped laboratories, smart classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and access to a huge library. The hostel provided neat rooms, hygienic mess, and 24x7 medical attention. There are cricket, football, and indoor games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College has strong practical learning and infrastructure, but faculty availability needs improvement
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Classrooms are highly maintained, and Wi-fi is available. The library is also provided in our college. The college hostels are good, but the food quality in the mess is not good. In the CUTM, they have a big sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Value of money for students.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi facilities, and the labs and halls are air-conditioned. There are plenty of computers available on campus, and they are all well maintained. Different types of hostels are available; if you want air-conditioned rooms, they are available, and attached bathrooms are also an option.

reviews.review_heading: Strong faculty & good jobs.
reviews.review_text: Our department had well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to a vast library. The hostel offered clean rooms, hygienic mess food, and 24/7 medical support. Sports facilities included cricket, football, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also quite good. We have well-equipped labs for all the different subjects like Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics, Pharmacognosy, Medicinal Chemistry, etc., along with smart classrooms. The main library is spacious and digitally enabled. The hostel facilities are decent, and the sports department is very good.

reviews.review_heading: An overall really good experience as a B.Tech CSE student!
reviews.review_text: The older hostels were quite congested and not very satisfactory. The food served is often criticized for being unappetizing and poorly prepared; some students have reported finding insects in it. There are many lab classes, but only two can accommodate 60+ students at once.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our courses like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are good. The quality of facilities in our hostel, the quality of food available in the mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: At last, it is the best college if u want to study.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities for students. All classrooms have AC and their own smart boards. All classrooms have their personal Wi-Fi. The best thing is that you can go to the library when you want for what time you want. They give good food in the hostel canteen and excellent facilities for hostel students. Also, present a personal doctor for the hostel and for sports injuries.

reviews.review_heading: The campus review of CUTM.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good except for its food. The hostel costs are also affordable. They are the most secure places. More often some clubs provide you with sports and entertainment purposes as we can enjoy the nightlife of the college. There a many stalls. We can enjoy being there and gossiping around with friends.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college with good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: College facilities are very good. The college infrastructure is also very good. Every single classroom has an AC and Wi-Fi system. The library environment is very good. The canteen food quality is not good. The food and hostel rooms are very disappointing.

More than 1,500 offers were made and 600 recruiters visited the campus during the PGDM placement drive 2024.

The PGDM batch of 2022-24 comprised 42% female and 58% male students . In terms of educational background, 36% enrolled students were from BCom background whereas 26% and 20% students were from BBA / BBM and BSc background. The remaining students were from Arts, Pharmacy, Engineering and Vocational streams.

placements.overview:
JIS University, located in Kolkata was established through the JIS University Act 2014, which came into force in 2015. The university encourages entrepreneurship & skill development among the students to promote employability & self-employment. JIS University Kolkata is approved by UGC, AICTE, NCTE, PCI, & the Bar Council of India. It is a private university & is accredited by NAAC. Further, JIS University in Kolkata is recognised as a Scientific & Industrial Research Organisation by the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research, Government of India, & is a member of AIU & UNAI. The university has strategic tie-ups with leading companies such as the Asian Institute of Technology, Assocham Institute, Nasscom, etc.

JIS University popular programmes include BTech and MBA. The university offers various programmes at UG, PG, and other levels. The college offers degree courses in full-time mode across several specialisations such as Engineering, Computer Application, Hotel Administration, Agriculture, etc. The duration of these programmes ranges from 2 to 4 years.

The JIS University Kolkata admission 2025 is offered in online mode and is merit and entrance-based. To get online admission to JISU, candidates must check the official website of the university. The university offers a wide range of programmes at UG and PG levels under various departments and across several specialistions.

admission_overview.college_name: JIS University Course Admissions 2025: Fees, Eligibility & Selection Process

paragraphs: JIS University admissionsare open for the 2025 session. The university offers various courses such as BTech, BPharma, MBA, PhD etc at the UG, PG and PhD level. Apart from the UG and PG courses the university also offers three diploma courses,i.e., diploma in Hotel Management, diploma in Food Production and Bakery and diploma in Fodd and Beverages services.JIS Universitycourse admissions selection criteria are entirely based on the university-level entrance exam called JIS University entrance test JET-2025 for UG and PG courses. This is to note that, the aptitude test followed by GD/personal interview will be practised for every course admission at JIS University.

The application process atJIS Universityis an online procedure. The deadline for submission of online application form for PhD courses usually ends in December (tentative). The PhD courses are offered in full-time and part-time. Read the following article to know more aboutJIS University course admission2025.

JIS Agarpara admissionsto all the courses are based on the entrance exam for UG and PG courses. The university also offers BTech CSE and BPharma Lateral Entry courses. The admission criteria for PhD courses are based on JISU-RET -research entrance exam (offline exam). Along with that, candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularJIS University courses:
Course Name
Eligibility & Selection Criteria
Selection Criteria
Class 12 with 60% aggregate with Physics, Chemistry as compulsory subjects
Class 12 with 50% aggregate from a recognised Central/ State Board or its equivalent
BSc in Agriculture (Hons.)
Class 12 with 60% aggregate with PCM/PCB/PCMB/ Agriculture
Class 12 with 60% aggregate and Physics and Maths should be the compulsory subjects
Graduation with 50% aggregate

JIS University admission process includes university level-entrance base exam registration, GD andpersonal interviewfor admission confirmation. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat inJIS University course admission:
STEP 1: JIS University Application Process 2025
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute for UG and PG courses. JIS University's PhD online application portal usually begins in December.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

The university shortlists candidates based on the JET +GD/PI. The admission criteria for PhD courses are based on the JISU-RET -research entrance exam (offline exam). It is always desirable and helps prospective students and their parents to evaluate the benefits and plans being offered for future education.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation

Once selection rounds are over, the university releases a merit list. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theJIS University feeto confirm their seats in the university.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my great JIS University.
reviews.review_text: JIS University has modern facilities and well-structured infrastructure to support quality education and the holistic development of students. The hostel facilities are comfortable, with clean rooms, adequate water supply, and common areas for students. The mess and canteen offer a variety of food options maintaining both quality and hygiene. Medical facilities are available within the campus, ensuring timely healthcare support for students.

reviews.review_heading: The best law university in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is good. The students get free Wi-Fi access throughout the university. The books are available properly. The classrooms are enough according to the student ratio. The canteen and hostel facilities should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JIS University.
reviews.review_text: There are particular classrooms for each section and department, and Wi-Fi is also available. A library is also available. If you want to read a book, then go to the library and sit silently. 2 time the price and twice the tiffin is available there. In the morning, they give tiffin, and also in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JIS University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has its own Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a separate library for separate courses. Wi-Fi is available for faculty and students also. There are separate lifts for teachers and students. At first the hostel of JIS is not so good but now the hostel of JIS University is very good. There is also a separate Wi-Fi system in all the rooms. But JIS University does not have its own playground.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, great placement assistance, qualified faculty, best infrastructure, and superb college.
reviews.review_text: One of the best infrastructures in eastern India. Computer Lab with all Apple PC, and 6 more labs with high-end PCs (Intel I5). Wi-Fi throughout campus (Speed 200 Kbps - 1.2 Mbps). There are more than 100 routers on the 10th floor. 3 gallery style AC classrooms and others are non AC. So good that Tollywood Mega Star JEETs film RAVAN was filmed, and also other small web series and podcasts were done. Library is good, and books are available. Hostel and Food are average.

reviews.review_heading: A good place to learn not only for a degree but also about life.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with AC classrooms and a lab, multiple labs, free Wi-Fi, a big playground with football bars, cricket pitch, volleyball court, an indoor table tennis deck, a badminton court, and a cultural room with instruments for the cultural enthusiasts.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college, you can take admission.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. In every semester, you have some interesting subjects, and also NPTEL subjects are included in syllabus, where you have to give the NPTEL exams to clear the semester. I am not a hostel girl. I do my college from my house. So I don't have so much information about our college hostel. I know that it is decent and food is also good at canteen though I have never tasted it.

reviews.review_heading: The college is so good, and facilities are helpful. The selection rate is better than others.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is always available in college. The hostel is good, but it's off campus. The food is good for health. In college, so many events and sports are conducted by the college. A district-level playing chance is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college environment is very student-friendly.
reviews.review_text: There are high-tech labs and classrooms with a projector. Many professors do not use digital screens or a projector. The food quality of the mess is average, and it has many options.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and beautiful vibe.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the labs is good. The library is good, but the classes are not that good.   Some classes have AC, but the maximum classes have a fan, and not all students can sit on chairs that are available on some days. All floors are cleaned all the time, and all types of sports events are included.

reviews.review_heading: It is regrettable to take admission in JIS University.

Laboratories do not have essential equipment, which is required for learning technology and practicals. Studying at JIS in the BMLT course is totally worthless. But the hostel is okay to stay in, and seniors are also friendly to enjoy college life. JIS is the best option, but not for a career.

reviews.review_heading: JIS University is very good for your future. Placement records are great.
reviews.review_text: Food in the hostel is available. We have a big ground in front of our university. The university hostel is clean and clear. The hostel is 5 minutes from our university. You get 3 meals every day, and the university also has its canteen where you can get delicious food.

review_content.Placements: I will complete B.Tech in Computer Science (2025-2029). Around 75-80% students are placed. review_content.Placements: The bulk of hiring comes from mass recruiters like TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, and Infosys. paragraphs: Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University admission 2025is conducted in both online and offline modes. Candidates near the University can visit the campus and purchase the application form from the admission office. Aspirants willing to apply online must visit the University's official website. Admissions to the programmes offered atDBUUare done on a merit basis for all courses. The university shortlists the candidates based on their merit in the qualifying exam. Students seeking to get admission to the courses offered at the university can refer to the following article to learn the detailedadmission procedure for Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University.

TheDBUU admission criteriaare merit-based for most of its courses. Candidates willing to take admission can apply online or offline. Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University offers more than thirty undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and diploma courses. The university accepts students for its BAMS programme based on NEET scores. Step 1: DBUU Application Process 2025
The application process is conducted in online and offline modes. Interested candidates can apply for admission either by visiting the official website of the university or the college campus.
Step 2: Shortlisting of candidates
The candidates are shortlisted based on the merit secured in the qualifying exam.
Step 3: Result declaration and Admission Confirmation
The University releases a merit list on the official website. Selected candidates are required to pay the admission confirmation fees to book their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Dev Bhoomi School of Engineering, Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University review.
reviews.review_text: The campus looks good from the outside. The computer labs are generally functional with working systems. admission_process.title: University College of Commerce and Business Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: University College of Commerce and Business Management is an institution of Osmania University and provides admission to postgraduate programmes such as MBA and MCom during the year 2025.These courses are entrance-based, and the MBA and MCom require TSICET and CPGET, respectively.Those candidates who qualify have to apply through the relevant exam websites and undergo the counselling process by Osmania University, where they are finally allocated the seats.The step-wise admission procedure is given below:
STEP 1: Application Process 2025

To gain admission in the required entrance exams, candidates should apply on their official websites- TSICET-MBA, CPGET-MCom.It is also mandatory that applicants have to register on the official portal (Osmania University admission portal).Through the application process, candidates are also required to upload academic documents and pay the exam/ application fee online.
STEP 2: Selection

Admission to theMBAandMComis strictly entrance-based. Selection for the MBA is done throughTSICET, whileCPGETis considered for MCom admission. Candidates must meet the minimum eligibility criteria specific to each course and category. The performance in the respective entrance test determines provisional allotment.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

The eligible applicants are called to counselling through the web by Osmania University.In the process of counselling, the candidates are expected to choose their course and take a seat by paying a fee (admission fee).After the verification of the documents and the payment of theUniversityCollege of Commerce and Business Management fees, one gets a final admission to the corresponding programme.

faqs.question: Is TSICET compulsory for MBA at University College of Commerce and Business Management?

faqs.question: What eligibility is required for MCom at University College of Commerce and Business Management?
faqs.answer: The entrance requirement for MCom at the University College of Commerce and Business Management is a BCom degree with at least 40 percent marks. faqs.question: Is CPGET compulsory for MCom at University College of Commerce and Business Management?
faqs.answer: Admission to MCom at the University College of Commerce and Business Management does require CPGET. The college does not permit direct admission without an entrance test. faqs.question: How to get admission in UCCBM Osmania MCom course?

faqs.question: Can I join OUCB directly?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot join OUCB directly. First you need to compelete your bachelor's with atleast  50% aggregate marks (for general category) or 45% (for reserved categories). The mode of application is online and offline. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can fill out the form by providing details, uploading documents and pay the application fee. Candidates can also obtain an application form from any of the campuses or from the marketing offices of ISB&M.

reviews.review_heading: VIT University: A place that you cannot miss in your lifetime.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are air-conditioned and smart classrooms, with projectors and speakers, and arch classrooms with rolling chairs. Every room is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. All the hostel rooms are highly maintained, and AC and non-AC rooms are available. All the rooms in the hostel have Wi-Fi connectivity. You have different types of mess options like veg, non-veg, and special.

reviews.review_heading: Bachelor of Business Administration at VIT University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really very good. They have good labs for students. Also, our college provides free Wi-Fi, but sometimes the signal is weak. They have a well-advanced, high-class library. I'm not a hosteller, so I don't know much about the hostel facilities. The rooms are neat and clean. The food was of average quality.

reviews.review_heading: A very good and decent college with nice infrastructure and lovely campus life.
reviews.review_text: A/C labs and a large library both are the highlights, I feel. It has the world's largest Thirukkural book ever made, which is located in the library. The full campus is very cool as there are many trees in it. Greenery all around the campus. Vellore as a city is very hot, but inside the campus, it doesn’t feel so.

reviews.review_heading: MBA from the VIT Business School, Vellore.
reviews.review_text: Campus of VIT Vellore is very good. This college is having a very good infrastructure. Labs, library, canteen, Wi-Fi, and various other necessary facilities are available in the college for the students. The college has a cricket ground, volleyball court, and sports facilities for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Helpful teachers and placements.
reviews.review_text: The college keeps its infrastructure very well maintained but we business people have a different department. There are facilities which involves classrooms with modern facilities, computer labs also. Hostels provides us amenities which involves mess facility, hygienic washrooms, bedrooms, etc.

placements.overview:
Jindal Global Business School, or JGBS, was founded in the year 2010 and is situated in Sonepat, Haryana. It is positioned uniquely in a variety of ways to offer an experience that is unique to students through its several undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral degree courses. JGBS is a constituent college of Jindal Global University, which has been declared an 'Institution of Eminence' under the 'UGC Regulations, 2017' for private institutions and the 'UGC (Declaration of Government Educational Institutions as Institutions of Eminence) Guidelines, 2017' for government institutions.

Some of the popular courses offered at Jindal Global Business School are BBA, MBA, and BBA (Hons)+MBA (Integrated. It has received a prestigious award from Fairtrade India and the Fairtrade Network of Asia and Pacific Producers. are offered to students at , , and levels in the stream across several specialisations. The college is also ranked as the in India by the , for the third year in a row.

Jindal Global Business School admissions 2026 for all the courses are open now. The college offers various courses to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. Jindal Global Business School admissions are entrance-based. Some of the popular entrance exams accepted by the college are SAT, ACT, UGAT, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc. The college also conducts the Jindal Scholastic Aptitude Test (JSAT) for admission to UG courses.

faqs.question: How are the placements of Jindal Global Business School for BBA (H)+MBA Integrated course?
faqs.answer: The 5 Year Integrated BBA (H) + MBA programme at JGBS is a very practical, multidisciplinary and Industry oriented courses which is consciously designed to meet the changing needs to the Job market . The first 2 years are designed to expose students to a gamut of courses which enable students to learn from diverse disciplines and help develop broad world view and launch a strong foundation for the future.• The courses cover a range of disciplines including Philosophy, Sociology, Psychology, Economics, Business History, Quantitative Techniques and Communication. The year 3 and 4 introduce students to the dynamic world of management and business in an engaging manner so that they can solve business puzzles. Students learn the fundamentals of management and its various disciplines - Marketing, Human Resource Management, Operations Management, Business Analytics, Finance and Accounting in 3rd year . In the 5th year offers students an opportunity to pursue deeper learning. Students have an option to go abroad for a one year MS programme in one of the partner universities. Students are exposed to business simulation and have an option to assist a professor in a business consultancy. They also have the options for working in a firm as an intern or to design and develop a new business idea and to start a new business. What makes the programme unique is : Global Curriculum Cross Electives : Freedom to opt for Cross Elective subjects from Law, Public Policy, International Affairs, Liberal Arts & Bank & finance subjects . Internships : 3 compulsory internships after 2nd, 3rd and 4th year in both corporate and social sectors Entrepreneurship : All the students have the option to register for RISE (Research & Innovation Semester for Entrepreneurs) in their final semester to design and develop one or more new business ideas under the guidance of leading entrepreneurs . reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Excellent program, good faculties, & a nurturing environment for all those who dare to put in effort

review_content.Placements: I'm currently in the batch of 2023-25 at IIMS Pune. Placements are underway and so far, around 35-40% of my class has secured jobs in well-known companies/corporates. Federal Bank is leading with offers in the 14-16 LPA range. The average package is around 7.5 LPA. Deloitte, FIS Global, Kuehne Nagel, Federal Bank, Mondelez are some of the top recruiters. The entire batch has secured internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: IIMS has various facilities including a hostel, computer labs, library, Wi-Fi, auditorium, canteen, modern and well-equipped classrooms with AC, smart boards, and projectors, sports grounds for cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, badminton, etc. ATM and hospital are right next to the campus. Overall, facility-wise, IIMS is satisfactory.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and the placement.

review_content.Placements: Till now, 95% are placed, and the highest package is 16 Lacs, while the lowest is 6 Lacs. Top companies are Asian Paints, Kuehne + Nagel, Mondelez, Deloitte, etc. All students got internships, and the companies for internships are Britannia, Haldiram, etc. Every company gives top roles, and the growth is high.
review_content.Infrastructure: I got every facility that a PGDM student requires, and the infrastructure is also good. Hostel facilities like a study table, Wi-Fi, daily cleaning, and food are very good. We get a different meal every day, which is healthy for our body.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty, good placement, really good infrastructure, and facilities.

review_content.Placements: The college has an excellent placement record. Top companies like Deloitte, Federal Bank, and Pattern visit the campus annually. The highest package offered is INR 24 LPA, and the average package is around INR 8 LPA. The placement cell is very supportive and works tirelessly to prepare students for placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has excellent infrastructure and facilities, including well-equipped labs and a spacious library. Wi-Fi connectivity is strong, making it convenient to access online resources. The hostel facilities are very good, with clean and comfortable rooms. Food quality is good, and the campus also has a well-equipped gym.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The college is very good and it also provides very good placements in the reputed companies.

review_content.Placements: 100% of students are placed. The highest package was 24 lpa, the lowest package was 5 lpa, and the average package was 9 lpa. Top recruiting companies are Deloitte, Mondelez, Amul and many multinational companies. 100% of students got internships. Brand manager, business development executive, and consultant are the roles offered in the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good. The classrooms are air-conditioned to get a cool mind while studying. There are IT labs where we can develop our IT skills, a library where we can get more domain-related books to study in our free time, and Wi-Fi is also available on campus. The hostel and mess are quite good. Pool, table tennis, football and many sports activities are done.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: It is a good college with better placements.

review_content.Placements: Our college has excellent placements. Almost 95% of the batch students secure jobs in just 2-3 companies. The salary packages offered are competitive with varied job roles. Top recruiting companies like Deloitte, Mondelez, Satguru Group, Pattern Technologies, etc., visit the college for placements. Some students received PPOs from their summer internship organisations.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is of average size. Classrooms are equipped with smartboards and mic systems. Classrooms are ample for the batch size. The hostel is only available for first-year students but suggested to view all hostel amenities in the beginning. A lot of PG and rental options are available in the vicinity.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good placements in marketing as well as finance.

review_content.Placements: The average package offered is 7.5-8 LPA. Top recruiters are Deloitte, Nestled, ITC, Asian Paints, Montelez, and so on. Almost 100 percent of students were placed who sit in the placement and winter and summer internships are provided by the college, which really helps boost our CV.
review_content.Infrastructure: Faculty is very supportive and infrastructure is good. It is a very good college if you are looking for marketing specialization. The food available in the canteen is very good and pick-up and drop-off services are also provided. The founder president, Sir Manish, is very supportive and interacting with each and everyone .
