reviews.review_heading: Excellent program, good faculties, & a nurturing environment for all those who dare to put in effort
reviews.review_text: IIMS has various facilities including a hostel, computer labs, library, Wi-Fi, auditorium, canteen, modern and well-equipped classrooms with AC, smart boards, and projectors, sports grounds for cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, badminton, etc. ATM and hospital are right next to the campus. Overall, facility-wise, IIMS is satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and the placement.
reviews.review_text: I got every facility that a PGDM student requires, and the infrastructure is also good. Hostel facilities like a study table, Wi-Fi, daily cleaning, and food are very good. We get a different meal every day, which is healthy for our body.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, good placement, really good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has excellent infrastructure and facilities, including well-equipped labs and a spacious library. Wi-Fi connectivity is strong, making it convenient to access online resources. The hostel facilities are very good, with clean and comfortable rooms. Food quality is good, and the campus also has a well-equipped gym.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good and it also provides very good placements in the reputed companies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good. The classrooms are air-conditioned to get a cool mind while studying. There are IT labs where we can develop our IT skills, a library where we can get more domain-related books to study in our free time, and Wi-Fi is also available on campus. The hostel and mess are quite good. Pool, table tennis, football and many sports activities are done.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with better placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is of average size. Classrooms are equipped with smartboards and mic systems. Classrooms are ample for the batch size. The hostel is only available for first-year students but suggested to view all hostel amenities in the beginning. A lot of PG and rental options are available in the vicinity.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in marketing as well as finance.
reviews.review_text: Faculty is very supportive and infrastructure is good. It is a very good college if you are looking for marketing specialization. The food available in the canteen is very good and pick-up and drop-off services are also provided. The founder president, Sir Manish, is very supportive and interacting with each and everyone .

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has decent infrastructure. All classrooms are well-equipped with smartboards, Wi-Fi, and AC. The food at the mess is really tasty, especially their veg biryani. The college has a collaboration with a hospital located on the adjacent side of the college, which is open 24X7 .

reviews.review_heading: Value for money, placements are good.
reviews.review_text: There are ACs, Wi-Fi, projectors, and digital smart boards in every class. Classrooms have a very cheerful environment. The college has a library, 2 IT labs, and Bloomberg Terminals. Hostels are good enough with Wi-Fi in every room, washing machines, etc. Sports and games happen often, monthly. Food from the canteen is okay.

reviews.review_heading: Best Experience in the college. Got great placement. Extremely happy.
reviews.review_text: We have amazing infrastructure in our college, which is improving as per the requirement. We are provided with a fully equipped gym, a library with thousands of beneficial books, an incubation lab for startup ideas to bloom entrepreneurship, and 2 IT labs with good computers and strong Wi-Fi. We have Wi-Fi support on all our floors and in the hostels 24/7. Our professors are equipped with smart boards, whiteboards, and projectors to teach us in the classrooms. All the floors are monitored with s...

reviews.review_heading: Unique, Extraordinary, Holistic Development.
reviews.review_text: Facilities over here are not top-notch, but whatever is being provided is at its best. So we have Wi-Fi facilities, which is 24/7 available. We have different labs, classrooms, libraries, good teaching facilities, and good sports facilities. I literally adore it.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for PGDM courses.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is very well. The college has a football ground, pool table for playing, canteen for lunch and dinner, and a library with a sufficient number of books for reading. The campus also has computer rooms for student practice.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the college, its placements, and faculty members .
reviews.review_text:
Good facilities and infrastructure are available in the college for the students to study there. 
Hostels are good for both girls and boys; many hostel wardens and hostel representatives are good. 
They are very supportive; the college mess is also good; cooks prepare delicious food for students .

reviews.review_heading: Good placement in 2023-25.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the PGDM course/Department are amazing. Students will have free Wi-Fi, two computer labs, and one lab for Bloomberg terminals. The classrooms will be well-decorated with modern infrastructure like projectors and smart LED TVs for better understanding of the subject. Students will have access to all the books in the library. The quality and facilities in the hostel are quite pleasant. Food is available in the mess, which is really healthy. There is ...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is very good and well-known for its placement in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: The college is well-equipped with IT labs, a library, and Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. The canteen is located within the college premises. There is also a playground for football, cricket, and basketball. The quality of food in the canteen is average as per the price.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement record of all time.
reviews.review_text: The institute provides us with a canteen and hostel services. The canteen service is very good. Every student enjoys it. It provides pav bhaji, sabji roti, South Indian, and also various types of food to students. In the hostel, there are washing machines and other facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: CMR Technical Campus is well known for placement.

content.Placements: The placement at that time was a great challenge for all students and the college. But our college had good placement statistics. The highest package offered was 14 LPA. The average package was around 5 LPA. Top recruiters who visited our college were Jana Small Finance Bank, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college had all the essential facilities and infrastructure required for our course. Wi-Fi facility, library with well stocked collection of books. Hostel quality was also decent, sufficient to survive. Food in the mess and canteen was good. Medical Support was provided by the college. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with decent facilities.

content.Placements: We ECE students are divided into six sections from the 1st year to the 4th year. Students who want to go into the software industry can get placement packages with a minimum of 4 LPA. Students who want to enter the hardware industry usually need to look for jobs outside the college, as fewer hardware roles are offered through campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: I have visited many colleges. Their infrastructure is insane compared to ours. However, at the end of the day, both provide almost the same facilities. Wi-fi is good. Smart boards are available. Lab equipment works in most cases.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has good placements and a good atmosphere.

content.Placements: 90% percent of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 14 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Google, and Microsoft. The top roles are software developers and data scientists. Around 70% of students got internships.

We have a huge library. The hostel facilities are good. The canteen is also available. The sports facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Represents the CMR Technical Campus, Kandlakoya.

content.Placements: Mostly, 70 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 42 LPA, and the lowest is 3.4 LPA. The top recruiting company is Cognizant. 80 percent of students got internships in MNCs like Google, Microsoft, and IBM, and they also conduct several national-level hackathons.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of faculty and good placements.

The college courses at UG and PG levels, including MBA, BTech, BTech Lateral, MCA, and MTech.Haldia Institute of Technologyaccepts national and state-level entrance exams like WBJEE, JEE Main, WBUT, MAT, JEMAT, WBJEE, etc. for providing admission. Haldia Institute of Technology is affiliated withMaulana Abdul Kalam Azad University of Technologyand the admission process is based on the university’s norms.

Applicants who want to be admitted to any courses must have to appear for entrance and counselling for all the courses. Read the below article to learn more about Haldia Institute of Technology admission process 2025:

Haldia Institute of Technology admissions 2025 is ongoing. Admission to all the courses is entirely entrance and counselling-based for all courses. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the courses they desire to apply. Below are theHaldia Institute of Technology courseseligibility and selection criteria:
Class 10 and Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biotechnology, or relevant subject from a recognised board
WBJEE+WBJEE Counselling
Diploma in Engineering from a recognised University
BE/ BTech from a recognised university
WBUT PGET+ Counselling
Graduation in any discipline
Graduation or BCA with Mathematics in Class 12
WB-JECA+ GD + PI
Note:The above eligibility and selection criteria are taken from past year data available on the official website of the institute. Hence, data might vary.

Haldia Institute of Technology admission process 2025 is open for all undergraduate and postgraduate courses. The admission is entrance-based, followed by a counselling round. Applicants must complete the admission process of Haldia Institute of Technology for admission. Check below the step-by-step Haldia Institute of Technology admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Candidates looking for admission to Haldia Institute of Technology in any UG and PG courses need to apply on the official website of the college The candidates have to register themselves for any courses by visiting the official website(https://hithaldia.ac.in/).
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Candidates need to qualify for specified entrance exams along with counselling and personal interviews accepted and conducted by the college to fulfil the selection criteria of a particular course. The college accepts WBJEE / JEE(Main)/JELET/WBUT/WB-JEMAT/WB-JECA for admission to BTech, BTech Lateral, MTech, MCA and MBA, respectively. Further, for MCA, the college also conducts GD and PI rounds for final seat allocation.
Step 3: Counselling
If the candidates get selected in the entrance rounds. The college offers the final seat to the candidates after the counselling. After counselling college allotted the final seats.
Step 4: Final Seat Allotment/Fee Submission
The college releases the merit list. After candidates get shortlisted in the selection round, candidates have to pay a certain amount ofHaldia Institute of Technology feeto lock their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college for engineering studies.
reviews.review_text: Our department has decent classrooms, a lab, and inside our department, there is a small library which contains only departmental books. Hostel food is not that good, but it is manageable and affordable. Medical facilities are available on the campus 24/7. The gym is also available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Boys hostel should be made available for all the years.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good or average you can say. Playgrounds are regularly maintained and the sports instruments are also well equipped. The labs are also average. Some are damaged but can be ignored. Library is quite big and there are lots of books which students require for their curriculum. The hostels are also well maintained and cleaned every week and the food is also average. There is one issue that only first year boys have access to hostels and rest outside.

reviews.review_heading: A balanced college with good academic and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has decent classrooms, labs, and Wi-Fi. The library is good for studying. Our library is open every single day and open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Mess food is manageable, to be honest. Our campus has good medical support and sports.

reviews.review_heading: An honest and well-defined review of Haldia Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at my college is well-maintained. Classrooms and the library are fully air-conditioned. The campus covers almost 52 hectares, and two sports grounds are available. All types of sports are played, and the college provides a gym. Hostels are good and only for first-year students. Canteen food is good.

reviews.review_heading: I am currently in my 2nd year, and I have seen a lot of other things.
reviews.review_text: Hostels have very good Wi-Fi facility, and a good mess with top and friendly wardens, but there's an issue that hostels are allotted only for the favourite people in the 2nd year, but in the 1st year everyone has been allotted a hostel. The teachers give night classes if needed in the semester and seminars.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive faculty and decent infrastructure, with scope for better placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and labs are decent. The classrooms are also good. The library is well-equipped, with all the books available for your course. Wi-Fi is fast and reliable. Hostel facilities are not very good. The college provides shared rooms with two students, study tables, chairs, bedding materials, and Wi-Fi. The food quality in the mess is not great. Facilities for sports and games are good. It includes football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, badminton, and chess.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment, average placements, but overall a satisfying experience.
reviews.review_text: The Civil Engineering department of Haldia Institute of Technology has well-developed academic and laboratory facilities. The department provides high-speed campus Wi-Fi, smart classrooms with projectors, and dedicated laboratories for all major subjects, such as surveying lab, concrete technology lab, strength of materials lab, structural engineering lab, soil mechanics lab, transportation engineering lab, fluid mechanics lab, and environment engineering lab.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely decent, according to me, it should focus on the changing world.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure is good, with good Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms are decent, but the locality is very offside. The quality of hostel accommodation is good, and the quality of food available in the mess is decent. Medical facilities are very good, with 24/7 ambulance availability.

reviews.review_heading: In one word, a fabulous college with strong infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course/department are fully air-conditioned classroom, smart board in every class, Wi-Fi present in every corner, and provide speeds of above 500. Quality of hostel is mind-blowing, provides double room at just Rs. 2000 per month, the mess fees depend on what you eat, vegetarian and non-vegetarian food is available every day. Medical, sports, all are 5-star, superb.

reviews.review_heading: You should not recommend choosing this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for a college course and hostel includes academic facilities like well-modernized classrooms and small libraries. Hostel amenities such as clean living space, security, and a recreation area. Clean and tidy rooms with basic furniture like chairs and tables.

reviews.review_heading: For a bright future, come here and also value for money.
reviews.review_text: Very good greenery campus, but the weather is polluted too much. If you have any lung disease, please don't take admission, the air quality goes above 150 sometimes, otherwise, this college is too good. Wi-Fi is available in each and every hostel, the food is decent, and the quality of food is too good.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if it takes the place of 4 to 5LPA gives a good roi and a life away from the city.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is nearly average with all labs with AC but majority of lecture classes have no AC facility and there is no Wi-Fi on the campus except for the jionet which has a 34mb limit. In terms of hostels hostels are allotted only to first year students and remaining year students can opt for nearby PG or flat. Hostel infrastructure is okay with average food quality and repetitive food.

reviews.review_heading: If you are looking for a good college, you can check this college out.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are quite good. I was wondering about the food but it is still quite good. I am in P5 currently and it is quiet. We have big playgrounds to play in, and we can play volleyball, cricket, and badminton inside the hostel itself. You can play some other sports too. But the out and in time is 7.30 PM.

reviews.review_heading: Haldia Institute of Technology is good college for study and placement.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of this college are good. Hostel is good. It provides all things like Wi-Fi vision and bed. But mess lunch and dinner taste like very bad. In hostel, all equipments are there to play games.

reviews.review_heading: Good academic facilities and supportive teachers. Hostel and industry-readiness need improvement.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers good facilities and infrastructure to support learning. There are multiple well-equipped labs in each department, along with full-time library access and campus-wide Wi-Fi, which helps students study and complete projects easily. Classrooms are decent and provide a comfortable learning environment. However, the hostel facilities are not satisfactory. review_summary.college_name: KCC Institute of Technology and Management Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent campus infrastructure with modern labs and a very supportive, knowledgeable staff.

content.Placements: The management for B.Tech is not good here. Very few companies came to college, which are not so well-known companies, and provide a package of 2 LPA to 3 LPA. Direct admission is possible. What I can that you should never take admission here don't never. It has no placements.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure, but no campus life. Never take admission here. Very bad reputation of this college in Greater Noida. The website is very useless, all things are done on WhatsApp, even the fees.
content.Faculty: Teachers are not so good, not so supportive. Everything is in the dean's hands. Even the faculty is not well-educated.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Average as compared for money and good enough for a better degree.

content.Placements: 5 to 10 percent of students get placement. According to the sources, the highest package is 32 LPA, the average is 5 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Infosys, Wipro etc. come to the college. 20 to 30 percent get internship in local company. Top roles are many. Other local companies also come to recruit freshers but gave low packages, that’s why they are not given in the ads of KCC. But a good percentage of students are placed in these local companies, and the students who have gained experiences and certificates etc., are placed in Wipro and Infosys.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied of faculty.

content.Placements: Placements are decent. If you are looking for a college with decent placements, this college is for you. The average package is 3 to 5 LPA, and companies like TCS and many others come to the college. The placement cell is good, very supportive, and decent.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is not very good, but the classrooms are top-notch and very good. The infrastructure of the college is very good, and the labs are also good. The library is perfect, I would say. The canteen is good, the hostel is decent for students, and sports events are also organized.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good, supportive faculty.

content.Placements: Around 50-60% students were placed in B.Tech CSE (AI). Average package is 3-4 LPA. Companies like Wipro, TCS, Infosys. Students from B.Tech CSE (AI) are placed in roles such as AI Engineer and AI Research Analyst. Around 50% of students are getting internships.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are neat and clean, and have a smart board in class. I don't have any knowledge about labs because I haven't had even one lab class yet. Food is average, not good or not bad. We have a lot of space for sports like badminton, volleyball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It's a value-for-money college, and there are some things you need to adjust.

content.Placements: The placement is alright. The companies come and place the students well. Otherwise, you need to prepare on your own and go for off-campus placements. Don’t totally depend on campus placement, so the placement totally depends on you.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel is nice, but you need to adjust sometimes due to some technical glitches in the lift. The food is well and good, they maintain proper hygiene, and the seniors are also friendly. The warden is the best you can ever find in any hostel. There are some restrictions, but it is normal.

admission_process.title: KCC Institute of Technology and Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: KCC Institute of Technology and Management admission 2026is open for various courses. The college offers courses to students at the UG and PG levels like BTech, MTech, and MBA. It also offers BTech Lateral Entry courses. The selection criteria are entrance-based. To get admitted to KCC ITM, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute. The application process atKCC Institute of Technology and Managementis conducted online. Read the article to know more aboutKCC Institute of Technology and Managementcourse admission2026.

KCC Institute of Technology and Management course admissionis completely entrance-based. Students seeking to apply for any of the courses offered at the institute must fulfil the admission criteria of the desired programme before applying for it. Applicants need to register and appear for the accepted entrance exam before applying for the course. Students can refer to the table below to know about the eligibility and selection criteria forKCC Institute of Technology and Management courses:
Class 12 with a 45% aggregate with Physics & Mathematics (40% aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category)
BTech degree from any recognised institute/university with a 6.74 CGPA/CPI.
GATE/UPCET(candidates who do not have GATE scores)
Graduate with a 50% aggregate
CAT/ C1 level proficiency in the English language based on theCEFR (Common European Framework of Reference Languages) + PI

KCC Institute of Technology and Management admissionsare primarily entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at KCC Institute of Technology and Management is as per the steps below:
STEP 1: KCC Institute of Technology and Management Application Process 2026
The application mode is online. Candidates must apply on the official website.
STEP 2: Selection

The institute selects candidates based on the JEE Main entrance exam for the BTech course and GATE/UPCET (candidates who do not have GATE scores) for the MTech course. Similarly, for MBA courses, candidates are selected based on CAT/ C1 level proficiency in the English language based on the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) + PI. Candidates' academic performance is also taken under consideration for final selection.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The institute releases a merit list on the basis of compound score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted candidates must come for document verification and pay theKCC Institute of Technology and Management feeto confirm their seats at the institute.

reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure, but no campus life. Never take admission here. Very bad reputation of this college in Greater Noida. The website is very useless, all things are done on WhatsApp, even the fees.

reviews.review_heading: Average as compared for money and good enough for a better degree.
reviews.review_text: As compared to other, our college has good infra and facilities. ATM is placed. Classrooms are very cozy and attractive. AC, Wi-Fi etc. are placed. reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied of faculty.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is not very good, but the classrooms are top-notch and very good. The infrastructure of the college is very good, and the labs are also good. reviews.review_heading: Good, supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are neat and clean, and have a smart board in class. I don't have any knowledge about labs because I haven't had even one lab class yet. Food is average, not good or not bad. We have a lot of space for sports like badminton, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It's a value-for-money college, and there are some things you need to adjust.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is nice, but you need to adjust sometimes due to some technical glitches in the lift. Food quality is acceptable, although it is not good one or two days, the college infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable B.Tech fees with decent infrastructure, but average placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good compared to other colleges and they just constructed a new building for B.Tech so its good and they have also made all the rooms air conditioned, canteen is good, spacious but not enough for all the students. The library is the best. Wi-Fi is average, not gonna lie, some classes not even have Wi-Fi, so we have to use ours. I am a day scholar but the hostel building is good. My friends are from the hostel but the mess is mid, and the sports culture is good.

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well equipped with modern technologies, high quality computer labs modern technologies and AI-ML labs and high standard modern technology equipped smart classrooms with proper Wi-Fi availability in the whole campus. Well sanitized and fully hygienic cafeteria.

reviews.review_heading: Decent and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent as only some classrooms have air conditioning while many classrooms do not have any AC. In the winter, it has no issue, but in the summer, we often face difficulties as there is too much humidity and heat around the room. Hostel facilities are also good, like we have decent Wi-Fi speed, the library has centralized AC and its quite silent which is ideal for studies.

reviews.review_heading: It's average in every aspect.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. Food is the worst. The course is great with no complaints about it. The hostel needs a lot of improvement, especially in terms of hostel management. Recently, there was a fire in the hostel mess, but we were unaware of it until there was shouting, and that’s when we found out.

reviews.review_heading: Know the truth, quality of KCC Institute of Technology & Management (KCC ITM).
reviews.review_text: The 40-acre campus of KCC ITM, Greater Noida, has an all-inclusive infrastructure comprising state-of-the-art, air-conditioned classrooms with the latest audiovisual aids, extensive Wi-Fi in all its areas, high-tech IT and engineering labs, a rich library with digital resources, and separate hostels for both boys and girls with modern amenities, such as AC rooms, gymnasium, and messes. Extensive sports facilities on campus include cricket, basketball, tennis, a swimming pool, auditoriums, medica...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, the campus is almost 60 acres, which is better than many colleges. Greater Noida campus is clean, and there are cricket, football, and basketball grounds, where you can play and practice. Overall, the campus is good. So campus life is fine.

reviews.review_heading: I don't recommend this college to anyone because of its placements, teachers, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is a bit okay. They have a good library and labs but on the other hand, the classrooms are not cleaned properly. Classrooms don't have air conditioners. They conduct regular classes from 9-5 like we are doing a job.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to take admission in and enjoy college life.
reviews.review_text: My hostel facilities are quite poor. They don’t solve your problems even after you complain for a long time. Wi-Fi facility is bad, and the mess food can be called near clean but lacks taste. Our hostel is on the college campus, so we have plenty of grounds and places to play.

reviews.review_heading: The college is above average, and I am absolutely satisfied.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually quite good, Wi-Fi is available in every classroom, which is good, and AC is provided in every classroom. The library is open 6 days a week, up to 11-12 hours per day. The hostel facilities are good, but the mess food is not just like home, but it's pretty well.

reviews.review_heading: Most of the students are getting job offers.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is top-notch. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, labs are properly equipped, and a central library is located with a variety of books. The hostel is great. Hostel rooms are properly cleaned, and all types of facilities are available here.

reviews.review_heading: An excellent college for an MBA with a majority of pros.
reviews.review_text: My college provides excellent facilities and infrastructure. The campus is spread over huge acres and surrounded by greenery everywhere, fostering vibrant campus life. Classes are present with smart interactive board and Wi-Fi access, a huge library with spacious seating for students, and a lot of books. There are 3 canteens in college which offer great food.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best universities for the MBA course.
reviews.review_text: Superb labs are part of this college. It has superb infrastructure and resources. Additionally, there is a library with air-conditioning that can accommodate 2,400 students and has all books they need. Hostels have state-of-the-art amenities, including two-bedroom accommodation, 24-hour Wi-Fi, laundry facilities, and security.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU: The hub of education and activities.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are very well furnished with e-boards, charging ports on each table, and Wi-Fi classrooms. The central library is very huge and has a lot of books to explore from. The food in the canteen is very hygienic and good in taste. There are many sports and clubs in the college campus which are very active.

reviews.review_heading: The average placement in the 2023-25 batch.
reviews.review_text: MIT is a Lyceum institute where events happen every now and then. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are all well-maintained with hygiene. The faculty is really good and will help you understand in a relatable manner. A few students dropped out of the course in the second year. From 140 students, we went down to 120 students in the second year.

reviews.review_heading: The security, safety and hygiene of MIT-WPU is really good.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus life is really great as there are a lot of clubs like tech clubs, sports clubs, personal development clubs, networking clubs. The sports offered, the large number of events hosted in a year, the canteen food etc. The books in library are mostly about engineering, business and designing. There are very less and rare fantasy books for fantasy and comic book lovers. The clubs are run by students, and the club is officially affiliated with companies like Google and Microsoft. The ...

reviews.review_heading: The campus is small but beautiful.
reviews.review_text: The college has many clubs, ranging from technical to social, including the TEDx Club, Robotics Club, Autosport Club, Art Circle, and Dance Club. These clubs have represented not only the college but the entire nation at a global level. Students run social groups and are growing themselves.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I will rate this college 8/10.
reviews.review_text: I think I loved the campus. Here, people from different regions come together but the majority are local. Wi-Fi is enabled on campus, in classrooms, library and hostels. Colleges have numerous labs, including computer labs and study labs. We have 3 libraries on campus. Central is crowded but nearly all books are available. You can use the library service for library books. The hostel is good. I like the food menu: eggs, bananas, curry, chapati, milk, and price. All are included; non-vegetarian o...

reviews.review_heading: Good college to start your career.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure offered by colleges is good, like digital boards, and college curriculum designed is good, which is relevant in corporate culture. Labs, Wi-Fi, library, canteen facilities are good, and hostel facilities are good. Security provided is up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Management, MIT WPU.
reviews.review_text: I am from Madhya Pradesh, and I don't know Marathi. In college, local people dominate, and if you do not know Marathi, this should be stopped. The college's outer infrastructure is good, but inside the classrooms, many desks are broken. Wi-Fi is available, but only in name. The library has all the books, but they do not give any books to students. Our hostel is pretty good, and their food is decent, but it is very expensive compared to outside mess food.

reviews.review_heading: Mit wpu Pune good or bad?
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure on campus is great. The Pune campus is Wi-Fi enabled, the classrooms have smart boards, and the library is well-equipped with all the books. The college canteen is great because you get various types of food to try. MIT is known for its fest in Pune.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and spacious campus.
reviews.review_text:
Classrooms are well lit, have facilities like smart boards, furniture is taken care of, and classrooms are always cleaned.
The library is pleasant, quiet and has many books for reference.
It's peaceful, the library is unique and the staff is helpful in funding course books.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Pune.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is great, with meals provided 3 times a day. They provide a bus service from the hostel to campus for 30 minutes in the morning and evening.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for your business administration course. Value for money.

There is also Wi-Fi system provided for faculty as well as for students also. So overall the infrastructure of the college is like any organisation and we get the actual feeling t...

reviews.review_text: Two years of our college life were online, so I cannot describe infrastructure. But the new building for MBA is impressive, amazing, and posh. Although, the placements matter and not the building. A good Wi-Fi connection is provided and a big library and good classrooms are also available.

Separate hostels for girls and boys are available. The mess provides decent-quality food, and the café and canteen offer good food items. An emergency medical team is present in the college. Sports and games events are organized regularly.

reviews.review_heading: In CS and its related branches, the average package is 3-5 LPA.

The academic buildings house spacious and well-ventilated classrooms, which are furnished with contemporary teaching aids. The institution boasts state-of-the-art laboratories for various engineering and Science disciplines, providing students with hands-on practical experience.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with this college. The faculty is helpful. It is value for money.

Provisional admissions are also available for final-year graduation students. After the online application process, students have to appear for a Group Discussion and Personal Interview round. Successful candidates secure their seats by paying the admission fees, ensuring their enrollment at ASM's IBMR.

To shortlist candidates for final admission, ASM IBMR considers the performance of the candidates in the national-level level exam and during the GD-PI round. The college also considers marks secured by the students in class 12, class 10 and graduation.
Apart from academics, weightage for participation in Sports, Extracurricular activities, Academic diversity and Gender diversity is also given.

Selected students will receive a provisional selection letter on their registered email. On receiving the selection letter, candidates need to complete the documentation process and pay the admission confirmation fee.

review_content.Placements: 10-15 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 12.5 LPA. the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average is 6.5 LPA. Top companies include Accenture, TCS, Amazon, the college itself, BNY, Deloitte, Cisco, Salesforce, etc. Around 78 percent of students got internships (for internships, huge companies like HP, Dell, BNY arise, and there is only 1 condition, to crack the exam).
review_content.Infrastructure: There is very great infrastructure; for example, films and web series were also shot here. Wi-Fi connectivity is good, but in classrooms, it is the worst. The library is very good. There is also 1 lecture allotted in your timetable. If you are a hosteller, then the library plays an important role in your life (not just for studies).

content.Placements: Placements are one of the major reasons why students take admission in my college. Placement percentage is well over 80% all across the CSE and other specialisation branches. The highest package that was offered to a student was 1.12cr from Amazon. The lowest package is around 2 LPA. While the average package is around 2.5 LPA. Since my branch AIADS is a new one, it's not possible find concrete placement states for my particular branch. However, this year we have seen that placement has not been very good. Very few students got placed this year. This year so far, 35% students got placed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Decent placements, the worst faculty members, small campus.

content.Placements: You can get decent placement from here if you are in the top 30-40%. Companies do visit here for placements. I know mostly service-based, but if you want only placements, then you can get 7. If you are aiming for a higher package, definitely look for off-campus.
content.Infrastructure: The campus size is decent. They provide hostels for both genders, but for boys, you can stay in the college hostel only for the first year, and then from the second year, you have to leave it. They do have all the grounds for football, cricket, badminton, volleyball, basketball, and all. Mess food is okay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Somehow college is great because of the college society.

content.Placements: 10-15 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 12.5 LPA. the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average is 6.5 LPA. Top companies include Accenture, TCS, Amazon, the college itself, BNY, Deloitte, Cisco, Salesforce, etc. Around 78 percent of students got internships (for internships, huge companies like HP, Dell, BNY arise, and there is only 1 condition, to crack the exam).
content.Infrastructure: There is very great infrastructure; for example, films and web series were also shot here. Wi-Fi connectivity is good, but in classrooms, it is the worst. The library is very good. There is also 1 lecture allotted in your timetable. If you are a hosteller, then the library plays an important role in your life (not just for studies).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The condition of labs in LNCT Bhopal.

content.Placements: The placement in LNCT is good. Most of the students get placed in good tech companies like Cisco, Infosys, and many more. The recent placements were also good. We do not have any placements yet, as we are in 3rd year and our placements have not started.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good. There are hostels for girls for all 4 years, and for boys, it is available only for the 1st year. After that, they have to reside outside the campus. The main issue is the internet availability in labs, as in most of the labs, there is no internet or Wi-Fi available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college has the best on-campus placement record.

content.Placements: I am currently in my 3rd year of college, pursuing a B.Tech in CSE. LNCT is one of the best private colleges in Madhya Pradesh with a good placement record. My elder brother also went to the same college and got three offers from reputed companies. The highest package offered to students is between 18 and 20 LPA. The lowest is around 3.5–4 LPA. Companies like Infosys, Deloitte, Capgemini, Accenture, TCS, and EPAM often visit our college to recruit students. Cisco also offers internship opportunities to students. I am not currently aware of the roles.

reviews.review_heading: Best private college for placement, but the overall campus life is very mediocre.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs in our college, and every single one of them has ethernet connection. The library has Wi-Fi for studying. One drawback is that you can't use a laptop or mobile in the classroom, even if you are using it for studying. The hostel is well-maintained and clean. The mess food is not very good, and the sports facilities are average since the ground is not very well taken care of. The hostel is only allotted for 1st year to boys, while girls can stay for the duration of their course...

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, the worst faculty members, small campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus size is decent. They provide hostels for both genders, but for boys, you can stay in the college hostel only for the first year, and then from the second year, you have to leave it. They do have all the grounds for football, cricket, badminton, volleyball, basketball, and all. Mess food is okay.

reviews.review_heading: Somehow college is great because of the college society.
reviews.review_text: There is very great infrastructure; for example, films and web series were also shot here. Wi-Fi connectivity is good, but in classrooms, it is the worst. The library is very good. There is also 1 lecture allotted in your timetable. If you are a hosteller, then the library plays an important role in your life (not just for studies).

reviews.review_heading: The condition of labs in LNCT Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. There are hostels for girls for all 4 years, and for boys, it is available only for the 1st year. After that, they have to reside outside the campus. The main issue is the internet availability in labs, as in most of the labs, there is no internet or Wi-Fi available.

reviews.review_heading: The college has the best on-campus placement record.
reviews.review_text: The college has big labs with good computers where students can code well, but the quality of the chairs are not good and can break easily. Students cannot use Wi-Fi inside the campus, and cellular data is blocked due to jammers. The rest of the infrastructure is good. The food is decent but not as good as home. The college has its own dispensary where students can get medicine for free. There is also a ground where students can play.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Madhya Pradesh and in a budget.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. There is nothing wrong with facilities. The college life is not enjoyable like other dummy colleges or government colleges. There are separate labs for different works and as per subjects. Facilities are good. It provides basketball, football, and other sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the placement, dissatisfied with the attendance criteria and self-learning time.
reviews.review_text: LNCT Bhopal has a big and clean campus with good classrooms, working Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs. The library is updated and helpful. Hostels and sports areas are okay and improving. Some buildings are a bit old but the infrastructure is good for students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worth the money, the faculty is pretty good, the environment is normal, but good overall.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty well maintained and updated every year. There are many facilities that are currently working and will soon be shown in the college. The fests are started and a good competitive environment with good study teachers, where good hostels are near, so you don't have to travel a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Really good education, best in class.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in your department are best, with Wi-Fi facilities and labs properly developed. Library has every material related to the course and other useful notes and books also. Mess, as per what I got to know, has good food. I have also tasted the food of a hostel friend the taste was very good.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a student of LNCT.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities we got are Wi-Fi, a moot court room, a conference room, a library, and good classrooms with digital learning. In the mess and canteen, hygienic food and water are available for us. The quality of facilities we get in the hostel is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for students but not good for technical education.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the hostel and college is quite good, with AC rooms and well-ventilated classrooms and labs. The quality of mess food is not as good but bearable. The quality of life is good but not as expected due to bearable syntax and overall configuration and troubleshooting skills and experience.

reviews.review_heading: Wanna join LNCT college?
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is provided in college, and they provide 3-4 computer labs. Classroom is average. Infrastructure of college is good, very big, and elegant. Hostel facility of the college is good for girls hostel only, not for boys hostel. The food provided in mess is average. Medical and sports facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: The fee is average in this college. Students get a good learning experience and enjoy studying.

reviews_list.review_title: I like the college location and faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Our college placement cell is very active, and they train us for campus placement. It collaborates with companies to arrange workshops and seminars to make us learn new skills. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the average package is 11.5 LPA. In campus placements last year, more than 300 companies have visited, and top recruiters are Amazon, Flipkart, TCS, Infosys, Accenture, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is best compared to other colleges. The campus is very neat and clean. The college library is equipped with many books, where you can study and prepare for exams. There is a seminar hall to conduct seminars, a sports club, and a single canteen. The college provides hostel facilities also, and it has a capacity of more than 600 students. Hostel food is good and hygienic also, in my opinion.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. L.L.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Promising placements, amazing campus life with excellent infrastructure and wonderful faculty.

review_content.Placements: I am currently in my 4th year of a 5-year B.A. LL.B. course, and thus far, only one batch has passed out from my campus from the School of Law, and that batch has not been placed entirely by the college. However, unlike placements, we are provided with excellent internships from tier 1 and 2 law firms and litigation lawyers for all year students.
review_content.Infrastructure: NMIMS is known for its world-class facilities and infrastructure. The college provides great infrastructure for all courses, including labs, a moot court hall, Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. The hostels almost look like a 4-star hotel with great food quality, although vegetarian. There are sports facilities, game rooms, a TV room, a gym, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Pharm. + MBA in Pharmaceutical Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good college, great culture and placements, and clean and tidy campus.

review_content.Placements: 100% of students were placed. The highest package was 10 LPA, and the lowest was 6 LPA, while the average was 8 LPA. Aurobindo and Hetero were the top recruiters. 100% of students got internships (paid) in different companies. Managerial roles are offered in corporate and industrial sectors both.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is well designed; biometric entry and exits are there. Campus is Wi-Fi facilitated. Classrooms are big and facilitated with air conditioning, with a smart board and a capacity of 60 students. The library is nice, and books for all the streams are available. The hostel is different for girls and boys, both having the same facilities. A general store, laundry, 2 TV rooms, and 1 game room, which has table tennis, carrom, chess, fussball, and mess, are located on the ground floor inside the hostel. A sick bay and doctors are available all day, and ambulance service is also available in the hostel and college. The campus has 2 basketball courts, 2 tennis courts, 5 cricket nets, pickleball, football turf, etc.

reviews_list.review_title: If you want a degree from a renowned university, this is the place.

review_content.Placements: Our first batch got placed this year, and I bet by the time you complete your degree here, you'll get good placement offers. The admission process can be completed online.NMIMS conducts exams such as NMAT and NPATbased on which students are selected, hence, registering for these exams is required toget admission in NMIMS. Interested students can follow the below steps to get a seat in NMIMS Hyderabad:
NMIMS Hyderabad Application
Students can go to the NMIMS Hyderabad website and register for accepted exam. Students have to pay an application fees and submit required documents toregister for NMIMS courses.
Selection Rounds

Students will be selected based on entrance for all the courses. Candidates must meet the eligibility and selection criteria set by the college as per respective courses. The university accepts national-level exams such asCLAT/ CUET/ JEE Mains/ NMAT/ NPAT, etc.
Merit List andAdmission Confirmation

Once selection rounds are over, the college releases a merit list based on entrance exam scores. To allow and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.

NMIMS Hyderabad fee structurecan include multiple components some of which are charged only once during admissions, while the remaining are to be paid annually or semester-wise. Students are advised to check the course-wise fees in the counselling round// offer letter and pay it accordingly. The university also offers a limited number of seats for its courses. reviews.review_heading: I like the college location and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is best compared to other colleges. The campus is very neat and clean. The college library is equipped with many books, where you can study and prepare for exams. There is a seminar hall to conduct seminars, a sports club, and a single canteen. The college provides hostel facilities also, and it has a capacity of more than 600 students. Hostel food is good and hygienic also, in my opinion.

reviews.review_heading: Promising placements, amazing campus life with excellent infrastructure and wonderful faculty.
reviews.review_text: NMIMS is known for its world-class facilities and infrastructure. The college provides great infrastructure for all courses, including labs, a moot court hall, Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. The hostels almost look like a 4-star hotel with great food quality, although vegetarian. There are sports facilities, game rooms, a TV room, a gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, great culture and placements, and clean and tidy campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well designed; biometric entry and exits are there. Campus is Wi-Fi facilitated. Classrooms are big and facilitated with air conditioning, with a smart board and a capacity of 60 students. The library is nice, and books for all the streams are available. The hostel is different for girls and boys, both having the same facilities. A general store, laundry, 2 TV rooms, and 1 game room, which has table tennis, carrom, chess, fussball, and mess, are located on the ground floor inside t...

reviews.review_heading: If you want a degree from a renowned university, this is the place.
reviews.review_text: Bro, literally one of the best infrastructures for college hostels. Wi-Fi is okayish, but everything is banned on Wi-Fi, so no gaming culture. Food is also okayish; the problem is the taste of every dish is the same, so everyone is bored of eating the same thing every day, so it sucks.

reviews.review_heading: If a student wants to do MBA then the 1st name after Iims Should be NMIMS.
reviews.review_text: We have spacious rooms for our daily lectures and all the classrooms are air conditioned and installed with wi-fi, so is the whole hostel. The quality of the food is also good and we get 4 meals a day which are good and full of all the nutrition that are required by an individual for their daily activity.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the placements and college facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very well-developed infrastructure. There are numerous facilities in our college for the students, including labs, library, canteens, Wi-Fi, sports fields, etc. The classrooms of the college are spacious and consists of projectors. The campus has CCTV everywhere for security. The cafeteria at the college is awesome. The labs at the college are fully equipped. The library of the college is well stocked.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is one of the top B-Schools with strong academics and best placements.
reviews.review_text: NMIMS Hyderabad has recently shifted to a new campus in Jadcherla. Facilities and infrastructure are of top class. Classes are good with smart boards, Wi-Fi and other latest technologies. There are also computer labs, library, etc. Medical facilities are available 24x7, and sports, games and events are organised from time to time. It has the best canteen.

reviews.review_heading: In my opinion, the Hyderabad campus is pretty good.
reviews.review_text: The fee structure is a little overpriced. The infrastructure of our college is great, be it the library, classrooms, labs, etc. The campus do no match to Mumbai campus, but it will be the largest among all NMIMS campuses as it covers 90 acres of land with good greenery, trees and ample space for any activities. The hostel is available on the campus, which is expected to open next year. The college is not in a very happening place, but it is average.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in our college are of top class. Internet connectivity is available. Labs are equipped with the latest technology. Each department has its own conference room where interaction with top industry-related people is conducted regularly. The college has its own hostel facilities with one of the best caterers in the country. Medical facilities are available 24x7 for students.

reviews.review_heading: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies has well experienced and qualified professionals.
reviews.review_text: NMIMS is one of the colleges offers the best diploma course with excellent facilities for e-learning and live lectures regularly. The exam centre is also very good with proper facilities as required in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The new college, incomplete infrastructure, academics wise okay.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good with smart boards and good sound system including mics, and Wi-Fi is provided. The library has a good collection of books. Food needs improvement. A doctor is available when required. Sports and games are organized from time to time.

reviews.review_heading: NMIMS Hyderabad is a mediocre college.
reviews.review_text: Campus is under construction. Only 1 building is there that also is half constructed. Only 2 floors are fully constructed. The campus is in the middle of nowhere. Once constructed it would be a beautiful campus but that might take 4-5 years. Hostel is not ye constructed. We stay outside the campus nearly 7kms away from the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure under construction, decent faculty, average facilities.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is under construction along with the college hostel in the campus. For the time being, students are accomodated in a rented lodge, food and other hostel facilities are barely average. Basic amenities are available. There're some issues at times.

reviews.review_heading: Top B School with good placements and exposure.
reviews.review_text: NMIMS Hyderabad has recently shifted to a new campus in Jadcherla. Hence infrastructure isn't upto the mark. However, work is being completed at a good pace and the minimum number of classes required by students has been taken care of. In the near future, the college must focus more on proper hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SVKM'S Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies - Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: Jadchelra campus is spread over 90 acres, and it has the design of optimum utilisation of land. It was developed with a concept that land and buildings will be with a positive contribution to the environment. It will utilise geographical advantage with a good green cover, and it will adopt renewable energy conservation methods. It will house STP'S and the treated water will be used for landscaping.

IBS Bangalore flagship programmes are MBA and BBA. MBA students secure positions in leading companies across various top sectors. Some of the organisations that visit IBS Bangalore are Google, PwC, and Wipro. BBA courses are designed so that students can gain the required knowledge and skills in areas such as Cloud Computing, Data Science, Cyber Security, Data Analysis, Data Visualisation, Management Reporting, and others.
ICFAI Business School programme equips students with various managerial competencies and leadership characteristics so that students can succeed in an increasingly complex and dynamic business environment. placements.overview:
Established in 1995, ICFAI Business School Bangalore is a part of the ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education (IFHE), a deemed-to-be university. IBS Bangalore is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC). The institute has signed multiple MoUs with national organisations and institutes. IBS Bangalore has eight sister institutes, namely IBS Dehradun, IBS Jaipur, IBS Ahmedabad, IBS Hyderabad, IBS Mumbai, IBS Gurgaon, IBS Pune, and IBS Kolkata. The college also offers scholarships to meritorious students.

ICFAI Business School Bangalore courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The college offers an MBA programme at the PG level for 2 years. Apart from the MBA course, the college also offers a BBA and PhD programmes to students. ICFAI Business School Bangalore admission to UG courses is based on merit. reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Nice experience in this college.

review_content.Placements: Students become eligible for campus placement from their 4th semester. Many MNCs like Deloitte, Wipro, TCS, Flipkart, and IBM visit our college campus to recruit students, and the average package was around 16 LPA, with the highest being 48 LPA. 95% of students get placement opportunities here in this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are very decent. Rooms are equipped with all modern amenities like a table, cupboard, bed, chair, etc. Many other useful things. Meals are prepared in a very hygienic way, and they give four meals a day. Wi-Fi facility is also there for students. The registration for opting for the college hostel is done on the college's official website.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Nice college, I had an awesome experience.

review_content.Placements: Students are eligible from 4th trimester to sit for placement. More than 25 companies come for placement during Oct - Jan for recruitment. The average package is 24 Lacs, and the highest is 51 Lacs. I have joined the product management role after completion of the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel is good with twin sharing. Need to share fridge and washing machines per floor. Breakfast is affordable and good quality. Rooms are allotted randomly. Common bathroom sharing with B.Ed cleaning facilities and basic things like table, chair, and almirah for each student are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Review of ICFAI Business School (IBS), Bangalore.

review_content.Placements: The highest domestic and international packages offered by IBS Bangalore stood at 18.80 LPA and 11.13 LPA, respectively. The average package of IBS Mumbai stood at 8.17 LPA. The placement record in IBS Mumbai at 2021 was 98%. Top recruiters in 2021 were companies like GOOGLE, ICICI BANK, EY INDIA, ORACLE, JP MORGAN, etc. Students after 3rd year are eligible for campus placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure and rooms are good. Rooms are very big and spacious for 2 people. Accommodation rooms also have attached bathrooms. Modern amenities are provided like washing machines, geysers, and many other things. The food they provide is very healthy and full of nutrition; they give three meals in a single day. Inside the hostel building there is one big library also, which helps the students in their examination time. Hostel rent is affordable to students, and registration is done at admission time.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Nice college and I am happy to study here.

review_content.Placements: After the 4th semester, students of postgraduation get placement opportunities. Almost 95% of students get placement opportunities every year with a good salary. The highest package went up to 40 LPA, and the average package was 15 LPA. Many top recruiting companies are Cisco, Amazon, Genpact, HSBC, JP Morgan, and Oracle. Over 150+ companies visit our college campus.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel provides residential areas to its students within 5 hostel buildings. Each hostel consists of individual rooms with an attached bathroom. Rooms are available either on a single-sharing basis or double occupancy as well. Room has all basic amenities like table, chair, bed, etc. Fully wi-fi-enabled premises with LAN connection is also provided to students. Mess food is decent and tasty. In the hostel building, there is a well-equipped gym also.

reviews_list.review_title: My MBA in ICFAI business school.

Otherwise, they can also submit their scores of other entrance exams at the time of filling out the application form. Aspirants must also pay an application fee of INR 1,800 via Credit/ Debit Card or Net-banking.

Admission at IBS Bangalore are based on merit or entrance exams such as IBSAT or GMAT/CAT/ XAT/ NMAT as well as last qualifying exam scores. Students who meet the exam cutoffs from before must appear for Micro-Presentation and Personal Interview rounds which determine final selections.
After the final result declaration, admission letters are issued to the selected candidates. Such candidates can further confirm their seats by paying the required amount of theIBS Bangalore fee.

placement_data.title: IBS Bangalore Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IBS campuses have its own Career Management Center (CMC) that functions under the guidance of a coordinator. The Center works towards offering better placements to students every year. The Career Management Center has maintained strong relationship with more than 4,000 organisations across India. The CMC conducts various placement-related activities such as Pre-Placement Talks, Guest Lectures and Workshops which acts a bridge between potential employers and students.

Recently, IBS Bangalore concluded the placements for the Class of 2025 with a 95% placement rate . The IBS Bangalore average package offered during the 2025 placement drive stood at INR 7.14 LPA. Further, the highest domestic and international packages offered during IBS Bangalore placements 2025 stood at INR 41.40 LPA and INR 12.76 LPA, respectively. The top recruiters of IBS Bangalore in 2025 included HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Deloitte, HCL Technologies, Accenture, PWC, Colgate Palmolive, Morgan Stanley, Zomato , etc.

reviews.review_heading: Nice experience in this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very decent. Rooms are equipped with all modern amenities like a table, cupboard, bed, chair, etc. Many other useful things. Meals are prepared in a very hygienic way, and they give four meals a day. Wi-Fi facility is also there for students. The registration for opting for the college hostel is done on the college's official website.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college, I had an awesome experience.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good with twin sharing. Need to share fridge and washing machines per floor. Breakfast is affordable and good quality. Rooms are allotted randomly. Common bathroom sharing with B.Ed cleaning facilities and basic things like table, chair, and almirah for each student are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of ICFAI Business School (IBS), Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure and rooms are good. Rooms are very big and spacious for 2 people. Accommodation rooms also have attached bathrooms. Modern amenities are provided like washing machines, geysers, and many other things. The food they provide is very healthy and full of nutrition; they give three meals in a single day. Inside the hostel building there is one big library also, which helps the students in their examination time. Hostel rent is affordable to students, and registration is done at ...

reviews.review_heading: Nice college and I am happy to study here.
reviews.review_text: Hostel provides residential areas to its students within 5 hostel buildings. Each hostel consists of individual rooms with an attached bathroom. Rooms are available either on a single-sharing basis or double occupancy as well. Room has all basic amenities like table, chair, bed, etc. Fully wi-fi-enabled premises with LAN connection is also provided to students. Mess food is decent and tasty. In the hostel building, there is a well-equipped gym also.

reviews.review_heading: My MBA in ICFAI business school.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities at the college. The infrastructure of the college is very good and satisfactory. Classrooms are big and fully air-conditioned. There is Wi-Fi connectivity on the entire campus. The college has medical facilities, sports, games, etc. The college library is big enough with ample space for sitting. The canteen has good-quality food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of its faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides good facilities. Classrooms are clean. The library has books related to courses. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. The hostel facility is not available in our college. The food served in the mess is good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college at this budget.
reviews.review_text: We have excellent facilities and infrastructure, like Wi-Fi, computer labs, digital classrooms with smart boards and projectors, a library, etc. Students currently reside in PGs and flats, as the college has not yet up with its hostel facility.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good placements but not good salary packages. Only 30% of students got good packages.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good here, and labs and classrooms are well furnished. There is no hostel on the Bangalore campus. However, many PGs, rooms and flats are available near the college. So, it is not a problem. The fee of PGs is a little bit high.

reviews.review_heading: ICFAI Business School (IBS), Bangalore is the best college for PGPM course.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are clean and beautiful. Our college provides hygienic food and a lift facility. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. The campus is clean and lush green. The library is huge, with a plethora and new edition books. The hospital is near the college, so there are no issues, and in the late-night, if you don't feel good, you can visit a doctor. Classrooms are beautiful and fully air-conditioned. Quality of food served is great.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college because of very knowledgeable faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very good with a very large playground. We also have a podium in the college building to arrange an event or something like that. You can arrange events like a fashion show, award ceremony, and dancing competition. They also have a basketball playground.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the course curriculum provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and living area is a main and important objective that a student chooses their college and hostels. The infrastructure of our college is modern. Our college provides a computer lab with well-equipped computers. Classrooms are Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available for the students are just apt. The canteen food is hygienic, and it offers a wide variety of options. The playground area enables one to take up any sport. There is a gym for students in the basement. Our college also provides a music room.

reviews.review_heading: Good Experience at IBS.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very decent, If we compare the infrastructure looking at Bangalore city, it is above expectation. Each and every sports activity is included in college curriculum. There is no official hostel by college. But local people provides good hostel and PG.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best, and it provides the best placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a well-equipped building and 24x7 Wi-Fi facility for students. The library is open even on weekends, and it is always updated with the new materials. Classrooms are spacious. There are 5 canteens. From north to south every food item is available in the canteen. The medical room is also available with all the required facility. Our college provides a basketball court, badminton court, volleyball court, and a huge ground for other sports.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with ICFAI Business School.
reviews.review_text: IBS has all the modern facilities like classrooms with audio-visual devices, Wi-Fi connectivity, a library with lots of books and newspapers. IBS provides a spacious campus to their students with a lot of amenities. IBS Bangalore has a good infrastructure, but there is no official hostel, but there are many other options like PG, and flats.

faqs.answer: Yes, BIBS Kolkata offers a two-year course of Executive MBA in Management, which is known as PGPEx. This course is affiliated to Vidyasagar University (VU). After the completion of the course, candidates are awarded the final degree by the VU. This programme is designed for the working professionals. Candidates can attend the weekend classes as per their convenience. To get admission to this course, a valid scores of either CAT/ MAT/ XAT or BIBSAT is must. The institute will also consider the score of PI round.
faqs.question: Q: Does BIBS Kolkata offer Executive MBA course in Management?

BIBS Kolkata admissionsare primarily entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at BIBS Kolkata is as per the steps below:
STEP 1: BIBS Kolkata Application Process 2026

The mode of application is online/offline. Candidates can fill out the application form on the university's official website. However, the application form is available for download on the website. Forms can also be availed from the BIBS campus by paying a fee of INR 600. Students can also check the detailedBIBS Kolkata feestructure here. Candidates must courier the demand draft to the undersigned:
Bengal Institute of Business Studies, 18D,
Lake View Road, and Kolkata – 700029
STEP 2: Selection

Students are selected based on CAT/ XAT/ MAT or BIBSAT + PI. Graduates or final-year students passing out in 2026 with a valid CAT, XAT, or MAT score are eligible to apply. A minimum of 50% aggregate is required for candidates from the unreserved category, and 45% aggregate for candidates from reserved categories. The final selection will be conducted after a Personal Interview with all applicants.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the institute releases a merit list. To allow and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.
