reviews.review_heading: BIBS has helped in revitalizing my career.
reviews.review_text: The campus comprises of three large buildings, relatively spacious more than enough to accommodate all students and faculty members. There is dedicated rooms for group discussion and extra circular activities. Internet is provided by the institute. Classes are conducted on whiteboards and via projectors. Food stalls and canteen are available and open 24/7 outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great experience and career development.
reviews.review_text: There are a total of three buildings under the Bengal Institute of Business Studies. One of them is dedicated to finance specialization only, while the other two are for the junior and senior batches of other specializations. The campus has Wi-Fi and all the necessary amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Absolutely dissatisfied with the overall facility and infrastructure of the college. The management is also not good. I am very disappointed with the washrooms of this college and no system inside the college.

reviews.review_heading: I think I made the best choice. I got the best academic support as well as placement support.
reviews.review_text: My college has 3 buildings with best resources. Also, a lot of conference rooms are there. We have a library with the best resources of books. The books also have digital and physical copies of books. We don't have mess or hostel but in nearby location there are a lot of PGs and messes.

reviews.review_heading: Arunabha's rocking review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good, and the courses are well-designed to help students learn properly. They provide training for placements, and overall, the institute makes students. However, there is no hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Not recommended this college to anyone.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very congested, and they are held in a flat-based campus. There is no proper library or auditorium. The seat intake is over 120 in each classroom, making it tough for us to concentrate on lectures among so many students. The toilets are not clean.

reviews.review_heading: A short review on Bengal Institute of Business Studies.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the entire building is covered with cameras; every classroom is equipped with an AC smart board and projector, as well as a personal computer for faculty in the classroom. The library is small but it is useful. The sports club is very good; they mainly focus on cricket and football for boys and Khokho for girls.

reviews.review_heading: Say a big yes to BIBS to achieve your goals.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very good infrastructure, like Wi-Fi, projectors, and air conditioning. Classrooms are cleaned regularly. Water purifiers are also there. The floors and washrooms are very neat and clean. The canteen present over there serves quality products at reasonable prices.

reviews.review_heading: Best Business College at Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The Teachers and Faculty members are very supportive and helpful. They always help and guide us in our studies. Our BIBS College has two campuses The Lake View the main campus and the Lake Terrace. Both buildings are 5 Storey buildings and classrooms are very well maintained and have good Wi-Fi and internet connection. In our college, there are various departments like Finance, Marketing, BADS, and SCM. Our college also has a Hostel facility available for students which is very near to our colle...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bengal Institute of Business Studies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available include 24 hours Wi-Fi, all the classrooms being equipped with smart projectors and the whole building having a centralized AC. There is no hostel in our college but the college provides PG facilities nearby. The college also provides rented flats.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to get admission in a B-school.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available, and smart boards are also there. They help to get hostels, and there is a library in both campuses. One campus is for classes, while the other is for admissions, placements, and some payment-related work.

reviews.review_heading: Very good campus.
reviews.review_text: This College campus are very good. Because in this college are many facilities and infra is available for PGDM course like Wi-Fi, many labs,5 library room and 30 classrooms. This campus also available cricket and football ground and medical facilities also have.

reviews.review_heading: It is a top-tier 2 MBA institute in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: All amenities were provided. Two campus buildings were there nearby. Campus was in the midst of an easily accessible, and posh area near lake gardens. It was one of the top 5 management institutes in West Bengal after IIM C, MDI M, IMI C AND IISWBM.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best MBA college in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: This college has big classrooms and all classrooms fully covered with ac and Wi-Fi connection. And all classrooms has a projector. The college has not any hostel. But you can find many hostels in that location. My friends get hostels within 1 km.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied that I have chosen BIBS for doing an MBA in digital marketing.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have 24x7 Wi-Fi connection, and infrastructure is very good. Books in the library are very beneficial to the students. We got the opportunity to show our extracurricular activities through the sports that are provided by BIBS for their students.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college for local Nashik students.

reviews.review_heading: Honestly speaking, the overall is good. I rate is 9.5/10.

reviews.review_heading: It is the top engineering institute in Nashik.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There are so many trees but never seen a mess of leaves there. The cleanliness is there. Wi-Fi does not work sometimes. The library is the best and it has many books. The staircase is very great with a peaceful environment. The food in the mess is not good. The hostel is okay, and sports are there. For a medical emergency, an ambulance is always there.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in college and my personal experience with the hostel, mess, and building.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good Wi-Fi facility throughout the campus, with a speed of around 150 Mbps, including in classrooms and the library. Facilities and infrastructure are well-maintained. We have many practical labs where students can perform experiments, which helps them gain hands-on experience. The hostel facilities are also good, with a hot water supply available. Wi-Fi facility is provided in the mess, hostel, gym, and canteen etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement in college. Last year, they gave 90% placement for the electrical department.
reviews.review_text: College is the best for the course and hostel is good. They give 1 bed, and 1 table to study in hostel rooms. They have playground and also canteen on the campus. They provide gym equipment and quality of the equipment is so good. And the food is also best in mess.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent with Wi-Fi all over the classrooms and labs. Classrooms are good and well-maintained. Labs are well-equipped with the required machinery. The faculty is also good. Hostel rooms are decent. The size of the room is small. The mess food is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good academics and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course was good. The labs were well-equipped with instruments and equipment. The library was well-furnished and had a modern design. The hostel quality of our college was also good, and there were limited sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with the facilities and placements that were held last year. (2024)
reviews.review_text: Modern, well-maintained classrooms equipped with audiovisual tools and LCD projectors. Both physical and digital libraries feature vast collections of books. Computer labs offer Wi-Fi access. Facilities include a cafeteria and a sports complex. Hostels provide well-furnished rooms with attached bathrooms, study tables, and essential furniture. Hostels prioritize hygiene with daily cleaning, offer nutritious food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, 24/7 medical services, and student secur...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, good patient flow, and very good in terms of studies and practice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. Huge campus and the best environment. You will love the infrastructure because you'll get amazing pictures. The hospital block has a lift, so it is very convenient. Patients are cooperative as the amount charged is much less for the treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure at DSI are good. The college has well-equipped labs, classrooms with smart boards, and a library with books for all courses. They also have sports facilities and a canteen that serves good food, though it is a bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with DSU.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are quite good in our labs and all the machinery works well in the labs. The quality of the hostel is quite good and the food is not upto the mark but comparatively it’s quite a good hostel. The facilities and sports activities are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure. Our college has a cafeteria, and canteen facilities are available. Wi-Fi facilities are very good, and classrooms are maintained neatly. The library has plenty of books, and we can also use the digital library. The hostel facilities are good; they provide hygienic and tasty food with a variety of options daily. The canteen is also available where students can gather in their free time and have a meal. Medical facilities are also good, with...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with this college and it's nice infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of this college are very decent. All the classrooms are fully equipped with high class infrastructure such as Wi-Fi and digital smart rooms. The computer labs are fully equipped with computers and AC. There is great Wi-Fi availability across the department. The Library is filled with information. I haven't been to the hostel but one of my friends stays there, he said everything is worthy including the food and the hostel rooms. In sports, every sport is availabl...

reviews.review_heading: Placements and faculty are good.
reviews.review_text: Our college is equipped with many good facilities, like good labs for practicals and clinics, good infrastructure, and a and a well-stocked library with a huge collection of books. There are many branches. Coming to the hostel facility, the food is very healthy and clean.

reviews.review_heading: My Bachelor’s degree in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Our institution comprises of various courses such as Arts, Polytechnic and Engineering. Each stream is allocated different blocks. 60+ buses are running from our institution. A maximum number of faculty members are working in our college. The food available in our canteen is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: A beautiful campus and a positive environment.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good enough for the students. The classrooms at our college are big in size. Labs have all the required materials, and the library has all kinds of books. The quality of facilities offered at our college hostel is also good, including tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: The best college of my life .
reviews.review_text: The hostel of our college is so good, as the rooms are so comfortable for living, and the rooms are daily cleaned by the hostel staff. If I talk about the mess, the food is so good, the menu changes every week, and we get healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study in.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility provided in our college was good with good infrastructure. It provided two sharing rooms. Our college has a canteen that serves only vegetarian food and is maintained hygienically.

reviews.review_heading: I made the best of friends in this college.
reviews.review_text: The university hostel fees is around RS 10,000 whereas the hostel fees for NRI students is Rs 1,50,000. As compared to the price of the hostel, the facilities provided were not up to the mark and the quality of  food was not satisfying. Hostel's basic facilities are decent. reviews.review_heading: My honest review of the college.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is quite good, with each floor having its own vibe and classrooms equipped with projectors for better learning. The library is also well-designed, offering individual study desks and fast Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are comfortable, but the mess food could be improved. Meals are available until 9 pm, and there are separate arrangements for girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement with good infrastructure, faculty, and great food in the cafeteria.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are pretty good. Proper cafeteria is available with good Wi-Fi support, and there is access to computers and the library all the time. They also provide headphones to attend online lectures in the library. Sports and games area is pretty good and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: PGDM in finance from the DY Patil B School.
reviews.review_text: D Y Patil B School has really good infrastructure for the PGDM course. The college has all the necessary facilities for the students, including Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, sports facilities, and halls. The college management also provides hostels to the students, which have good quality facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Dedicated faculty of the B-School.
reviews.review_text: The college provides all essential facilities for effective learning including a computer lab, smart classrooms, library and counselling room. To help students manage stress, various extracurricular activities are available such as music, drama, dance, and Zumba. Although I live off-campus, friends who reside in the college hostel report that it is well-maintained and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for education.
reviews.review_text: Each and every infrastructure is decent; each floor has its unique ways. There are projectors also for easy learning; college gives professional vibes. In the library, separate desks, WLAN, and Wi-Fi are provided. The hostel is good, but the mess is not that good; it feels like 72,000 breakfast, dinner, and lunch can be availed till 9 pm in mess 1-5 floor for girls and the rest for boys.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent Education is provided at this college.
reviews.review_text: Top-notch facilities! Modern classrooms equipped with Wi-Fi, a well-stocked library, state-of-the-art labs. Hostel offers comfortable living, nutritious meals, and medical care. Extensive sports facilities for all enthusiasts. A holistic environment fostering academic and personal growth.

reviews.review_heading: Most dedicated college towards their work & words.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities that a student needs for comfortable learning are available there like computer lab, smart classrooms, library, counselling room and many more. Also, to relieve the stress, there are also extra - curriculum activities like music, drama, dance, zumba, etc. I don't know much about the hostel as I stay outside the college hostel but according to my friends who stay in college hostel, the hostel is well maintained and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements, a good ambiance, and satisfactory academics.
reviews.review_text: There is no boys hostel, but it will be available in a few years maybe. The canteen is good, and Wi-Fi is available. Sports activities also keep happening.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with great opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure campus in Pune with updated technologies. Beautiful environment, best indoor and outdoor facilities. Totally air conditioned classrooms, wide varieties of books available in library. Great computer labs, playing court and much more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a great infrastructure with elevator and the food served is good and cheap,
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are very airy and good in condition. The library is full of books and magazines, with proper seating facilities. As the computer lab is new, so everything out there is perfect. Wi-Fi sometimes takes away your calmness. The elevator is primarily used by teachers or by PG students. The facility of the hostel is available behind the campus and is good. The infrastructure is new. Mess facilities were earlier only for hostel students and then were offered to other students of colle...

reviews.review_heading: A complete package for a student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided - Wi-Fi, well developed computer lab and library, variety of daily newspaper, AC classrooms, projectors and professional podiums etc. State of the art infrastructure with comfortable seating arrangements and clean and hygienic mess as well as canteen. Also the campus is having an inhouse store where the students can purchase stationaries and edibles.

reviews.review_heading: A great college to kick start your career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. They will provide and fulfil all needs and demands of a student. The college has 2 labs. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The food available in the canteen is adjustable. Hostels are in good condition. There is a big space right in front of the college for events, and everything happens from college event to sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and really good infrastructure and facilities good event management .
reviews.review_text:
Yes,  they provide Wi-Fi for all students, and their are smart classrooms library access is given to all students, as well as an amazing library in our college. 
The 2022 canteen is like fully amazing place, where all students are seated their and enjoy their foods and for all students, medical facilities are free .

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with placements , faculty  and infrastructure
reviews.review_text:
We have computer lab, smart rooms , smart tv in every classes, student wifi, library
Hostel facilities are great and quite strict for the students, food provided is healthy , they provide 4 time meal to the students 
Canteen facility is also there
Sports events are organised and once in a year we have our fest also all the festivals are celebrated

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, supportive faculty members, and strong industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: It offers excellent infrastructure and facilities. On-campus has Wi-Fi enabled, and classrooms are so modern. It has a digital library with physical books. We have smart board facilities and a wide range of management books available. We can have group discussions and projects.  Hostel facilities are decent and well-maintained. Rooms are looking very fancy.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Love the college and its value for money.

content.Placements: NICMAR has achieved 100% placements in multiple courses and categories. Over 200 reputed companies participated in the placement drive. Spanning sectors like construction, real estate, consulting, IT, design, and many more. Notable recruiters included Ultratech, L&T, Infosys, and TCS.
content.Infrastructure: The campus spans approximately 11 acres. The college is located in Balewadi. The campus offers lush greenery with contemporary collaboration. Classrooms and lecture halls are fully equipped with air conditioning and a comfortable seating arrangement. It can accommodate a healthy strength with ease.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated MBA - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: IMBA at Nicmar University Pune - Worth it?

content.Placements: Most of the MBA students graduated with a minimum of 6 LPA. I don't know what college claims, the average is 10 LPA or 12 LPA but in reality the average package is 7 LPA. But as this is NICMAR there are chances that you will get into construction related companies in managerial roles.
content.Infrastructure: The course infrastructure is solid, with well-equipped classrooms and computer labs tailored for management students. Business school is expanding, and a new building is set to open next year, easing current scheduling adjustments. Hostel facilities are good. Boys have single rooms, while girls can choose between shared or single occupancy. Wi-Fi is reliable, and washrooms are clean.

content.Placements: The college has a 99.9% placement rate every year. individual_reviews.course: Master of Planning (M.Plan) (Urban Planning) - Batch of 2022

content.Placements: Placements were pretty good and the graph was raising on the positive side. Almost 250 companies visited to offer more than 1250 offers. KPMG offered 8 LPA, PWC offered 7 LPA, Goldman Sachs offered 8 LPA, Tata Steel offered 9.5 LPA, Reliance offered 8 LPA, L&T Construction offered 6.5 LPA, Lodha Group offered 6.5 LPA, Samsung offered 7 LPA, HCC offered 7 LPA, and many other reputed companies. individual_reviews.course: MBA in Advanced Construction Management - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of college.

content.Placements: The current status of placements is 99.9% at NICMAR. Almost every top Indian company comes for the recruitment process. My internship will be in January, but I know from past records. headings.text: NICMAR Pune Admission 2025: Highlights
NICMAR Pune Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection Process
Stepsfor NICMAR Pune Admission Process 2025

lists: Class 12 with 60% aggregate
Graduation with 50% aggregate

At NICMAR University, candidates selected for PG coursesare scrutinised and eligibility would be decided based on the documents submitted. Eligible candidates will be invited to appear for the selection process, which includes the Post Graduate NICMAR Common Admission Test (PG-NCAT), Personal Interview (PI) and Rating of Application (RA).

Valid scores of the applicants appearing for CUET PG / MH-CET / CAT / MAT / XAT / NMAT / ATMA will be measured as a substitute for PG-NCAT (Written Test) for MBA & PGD programmes. Scores of GATE (AR / Civil) will be measured as different for PG-NCAT (Written Test) for the MPlan programme. For candidates appearing in NCAT & other added entrance exams (as mentioned above), the highest score among such exams will be deliberated for closing merit list.

For UG courses-Valid scores of UGAT / IPMAT (IIM Indore) / CUET UG will be measured as an alternate for UG-NCAT for the BBA/BBA (Hons)/Integrated MBA programme. For BTech Civil Engineering course, valid scores of JEE / MH CET / PERA / CUET UG / Other States CET will be deliberated as another for UG-NCAT. For candidates appearing in NCAT & another additional entrance exam (as mentioned above), the highest score between these exams will be considered to create the final merit list. The selection of candidates is done based on the merit list mentioned above. Admission offer letters are issued in the order of merit.

For BArch course-The candidates will be scrutinised and eligibility is established based on the documents submitted. Applicants should Qualify for the National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) or JEE Paper 2 (NTA). Students are required to appear for a Counselling Session at NICMAR University, Pune. The admission will be based on the candidate’s NATA score or JEE Paper 2 (50% weightage) and exam score of the Class 12 examination or Graduation Diploma examination (50% weightage).

reviews.review_heading: Love the college and its value for money.
reviews.review_text: The campus spans approximately 11 acres. The college is located in Balewadi. The campus offers lush greenery with contemporary collaboration. Classrooms and lecture halls are fully equipped with air conditioning and a comfortable seating arrangement. It can accommodate a healthy strength with ease.

reviews.review_heading: IMBA at Nicmar University Pune - Worth it?
reviews.review_text: The course infrastructure is solid, with well-equipped classrooms and computer labs tailored for management students. Business school is expanding, and a new building is set to open next year, easing current scheduling adjustments. Hostel facilities are good. Boys have single rooms, while girls can choose between shared or single occupancy. Wi-Fi is reliable, and washrooms are clean.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are of good quality. The food provided is vegetarian only. The hostel capacity per batch is  600 students. The cost for a single room with mess is nearly Rs. 30,000. For a double room with a mess is Rs. 25,000. Although the internet is not good, it is free and included in the fees. Working for almost 3 years, I got to see how an organisation works. I am fascinated by the management. I want to be a part of such a team, but before that, I want to learn more about it structura...

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: Quality hostel facilities were food veg only, capacity per batch 600 single mess cost near Rs 30,000. Double mess cost was Rs 25,000, and internet was not good although it was free included in the fee.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is not availed as it is a part-time course, but I have heard from seniors and friends doing full-time that food is okay in the mess. Since the college and hostel are highly subsidized, the mess and canteen are affordable, and apart from that, there is a big ground.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities rooms are too clean, just like new. Daily, they maintain cleanliness in the hostel, and every summer, they repaint the rooms. Mess food is of good quality and hygienic. The best thing is that you can have a single room or a double room, it's your choice, but the cost can vary accordingly. We have a high-speed internet connection.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at this college.
reviews.review_text: The course structure offered by this college is pretty awesome and not only one course in every course. They have incorporated the subject which will be very helpful in gaining knowledge and as well as in getting the right job in a particular field. Hostel facility is good considering you get single rooms in your final year and this time even first-year students get single rooms. There are 6-7 options to choose from different messes like North mess, South mess, Andhra mess, Kerala mess, pure veg...

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel life and facilities are very good. It is always neat and clean and very safe for all. All cleaning staff members do their work in a timely manner. Guards are very responsible for their work. Room sizes are adequate for individuals. Mess food is good, and we will get a variety of food. Hygiene is maintained inside the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Two year full-time course.
reviews.review_text: The college is known for its flexible learning with good recognition in their standards of giving quality education. Libraries were shifted to the middle of the campus which would be easier for all the students from various disciplines. Hostel charges are so expensive for the hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: The course has value for the money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is built with required features like indoor and outdoor sports facilities, dedication rooms, yoga classes, fitness centers so on. As parking features and other areas are sanitized so neatly. All the students are secure and protected on the campus of our college.

reviews.review_heading: Solid placements and supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: I am giving the infrastructure a full 5-star rating because I honestly think it's top-notch. The facilities for my course are really well-maintained. The labs are equipped with the latest technology relevant to our field. Classrooms are spacious and have good audio-visual systems.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good standards and recognition from people.
reviews.review_text: The college is well-known for its excellent services. The transportation and accommodation services are quite good and easily adoptable by students from all economical backgrounds.

reviews.review_heading: I am a 2025 batch student from the discipline of M.Plan.
reviews.review_text: Hostel wardens and in-charges are the main representatives of the hostel and take care of all the problems and satisfy the needs. Hostels are maintained with a tight security system and all the relaxing activities within. Students from various rural/urban areas choose our university and are doing their courses.

reviews.review_heading: MBA in advanced project management.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are so modern with comfortable seating arrangements. An uninterrupted power supply is available in all classrooms and laboratories. Prior information is required to join the hostel rooms. Otherwise, it may result in delays in getting rooms. Hostels are a little bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: M.Plan in the college of NICMAR University, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of NICMAR University looks like an IT infrastructure campus with network connectivity, email services, and fax. Students from diverse locations plan to do their courses while considering its reputation in architecture fields. The best thing is we are able to explore a lot in this university.

individual_reviews.title: A good college in a good location with a nice campus and faculty members.

content.Placements: Many companies visit the college for placements for the year 2025. Some students got placements at companies. The placement cell also works hard to make sure students get their preferred job role. I guess the highest package offered is 8 or 9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The B.Tech classrooms are nice. Labs are also well-maintained. It provides a good space for sitting and reading in the library. GLS College doesn't have its own hostel, but they have tie-ups with the hostel. The Hive Hostel is nice, and I stay there only.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Life at GLS University where you can experience your life's best 3 years.

content.Placements: If we have 100 students, many students don't appear in placement because they want to pursue an MBA, and those who appeared in placement got the placement, but not everyone got a good placement. After completion of the registration process, the institute shortlists candidates based on their merit in the last qualifying exam or entrance exam scores. For PGDM, IIHMR Delhi accepts Management entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, etc. The institute also conductsIIHMR MATto select candidates for MBA programme. Admission to FPM is based on GMAT, GRE, CAT, JRF or FPET scores. For all other courses, merit in the last qualifying exam is considered for admission. The institute also calls selected MBA students for a personal interview and Group Discussion round to examine their communication skills, expertise, and confidence level, among other things.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

After completion of the selection rounds, final shortlisted aspirants recieve a confirmation letter. Aspirants need to pay theIIHMR Delhi feesto confirm their seat in the institute. The admission offer is cancelled within 14 days if the candidate will not submit the first installment.

reviews.review_heading: IIHMR Delhi - Wings to your dreams.

The college is fully air-conditioned, Wi-Fi. The campus has all the facility of the gymnasium, courts. Hygiene is an important parameter when talking about the canteen and overall campus.

The college also has a very student friendly Library which has all the latest books, research papers and reading material of the health sector.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a great opportunity for healthcare management students.
reviews.review_text: IIHMR has a huge campus. Our college offers free a Wi-Fi facility, and the classrooms are huge and spacious. There is a full-fledged library, seminar rooms, hall and volleyball court. The food offered here is of good quality, and the hostel rooms are clean and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and comfortable too. Proper Wi-Fi facilities and labs with all facilities are provided by our college. Apart from the course or subject, IIHMR also provides various other programs and research programs, which are important for students. Our college also conducts various curricular activities to enhance our skills. Various presentations and assignments are given on a weekly basis so that students can learn time management.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and exposure to market, good placement record .
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good, library is also well constructed all classroom are good with Air conditioning and canteen is also good, Wi-Fi is provided to student's, computer labs is also there, fees was 6,  45000 during our batch. Hostel fees around 75000 per year .

reviews.review_heading: Excellent Infrastructure and Best when come to Quality Education.
reviews.review_text: Separate I. T Lab, WI-FI Campus, Library resources having access to various high impact factor journals, articles etc. Classrooms are big and well lighted with smart LED screen, Sound facility is also there. IIHMR only provide accommodation to girls on first come first basis, although there are easily available flats, PG around the institution, Canteen provide good nutritious meal. Campus is equipped with various indoor and outdoor game complexes.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the good faculty and also the 100 % placement.
reviews.review_text: There is a facility of Wi-Fi in the campus and the classrooms are big, there are 2 big computer labs. There are lots of magazines and novels related to health. Every year they organise sports day for at least two weeks. They provide PG for boys and hostel for girls where facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Is place of public health.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is good. In college campus we have so much space for the other activities. In college campus gym, badminton's court and auditorium was available. Fully AC classroom. Computer lab remains open for everyone for printouts and internet. Guest rooms are as good as any hotel.

reviews.review_heading: An excellent opportunity to take your career to new horizons.
reviews.review_text: The institute offers all the amenities and services required for best learning opportunities. High-speed internet facilities are available in classrooms, library and auditorium. The institute also provides a fully functional gymnasium and recreational area along with indoor/outdoor games facilities besides a sick room which works as the infirmary. The canteen provides food and snacks throughout the day. They also provide accommodation facilities for guests, which can be availed through prior boo...

reviews.review_heading: Certainly join to grow professionally and personally with excellent mentorship.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well oriented. During lecture we are provided with class material, books, PPT, videos etc. Library here provides us with all the necessary and additional books and books also access to various reputed journals, and also very supportive library staff.

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended to the aspirants looking for boosting career in health industry.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-equipped with the latest technologies in classrooms. Library has wide array of books apart from curriculum which allow students to know about the current trends in the sector. College has sports facility in the campus which helps students to relax and at the same time, every year sports event are being organised for students and faculty members at a big level.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of faculty members, course, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The college is well-equipped with all the modern facilities like Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, smart classrooms, computer labs, and a library with all the latest health and hospital journals. The campus also has the facility of gymnasium and courts. The food served in the canteen is hygienic.

lists: Mangalayatan University admissions begin with the application procedure. students who want to apply can download the application forms from the university’s official website. paragraphs: St. Joseph College of Engineering admission is based on merit for some courses and on entrance exam scores for others.St. Joseph’s College of Engineeringis a private engineering college affiliated withAnna University, Chennai. The college offers degree programmes majorly in the field of engineering and technology. The college accepts national-level and state-level entrance exams, such as GATE, TANCET and TNEA. for admission to courses, namely MTech, MBA and BTech, respectively. St. Joseph College of Engineering offers four courses at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the fields of Engineering, Technology and Management. Candidates can apply for admission online through the official website.

St. Joseph College of Engineering admission to most of the courses is based on the performance of the candidate in the entrance exam except for BBA. Admission to the SJCE BBA course is based on the merit secured by the candidate in the qualifying exam. Candidates, however, for all courses are required to meet minimum eligibility criteria to get shortlisted for any and every course offered by SJCE. reviews.review_heading: The right path to our future.
reviews.review_text: The college has a sizable library with almost all the books we want. Canteens that offer delectable snacks at affordable prices, and smart boards that let students learn subjects through visual aids. Snacks cultivated and made on campus are more affordable. Students can get whatever they need at this college because it has the best facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I'm absolutely satisfied because of the seniors.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of our college are good, and the infrastructure looks very traditional, as well as innovative. They split the students into two types, one is HOPE, and the second is PEP. There is a library with many articles, and compared to other colleges, our college food is so good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, faculty members, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The college provides quality food, clean and well-maintained hostels. Spacious grounds that encourage students to engage in various sports and physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: Having a good experience at this college. It has good placements.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with spacious classrooms, fully air-conditioned computer and research labs and high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the academic blocks. Campus also includes a well-stocked central library with digital access to journals and e-books relevant to our course. Smart boards and projectors are available in most classrooms to support interactive learning. The hostels offer good infrastructure with clean rooms, 24X7 water and electricity, and Wi-Fi access. The quality of food in the me...

reviews.review_heading: The college that makes my dream come true.
reviews.review_text: The department offers Wi-Fi connections, a modern lab with A/C facilities, a smart class is also there and they have a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean with basic amenities and the food provided in the mess is tasty. Also, they have canteen and the prices are very less compared to other canteens and good medical facilities. They also have an indoor and outdoor court to ensure the balance of the student.

reviews.review_heading: College has nice infrastructure and great faculty, but students still couldn't get enough exposure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, with many facilities, and it is also easy to fit in quickly. The hostel infrastructure is not that great, because the rooms are not worth the fees we pay every year. It is a decent place to stay.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a bright future for the youth.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available like Wi-Fi, 3 Labs, classrooms, library, smart classrooms, dispensary room, etc. Hostel is available with 24/7 Wi-Fi, good quality beds and pillows, twice daily room cleaning, laundry facilities, unlimited good-quality food, and a very large playing area.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with very high fees.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is okay. But the hostel infrastructure is very poor. A Wi-Fi facility is available in the hostel and college. The hostel's Wi-Fi is poor. In 1st year hostel, there is no space for air to come in. In the second-year hostel, the air is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment, but placements are good in the earlier stage. College is strict.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the department is good but the Wi-Fi facilities are weak. Labs and classrooms are good. In the classroom, there is no Wi-Fi. The network is also low. Library is good. The food is excellent. In our college, it's compulsory to pay fee for food. Canteen is not good. Medical facilities are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Choose the best needed to become the best.
reviews.review_text: There will be canteen facilities, drinking water facilities, a gym, and a large library that consists of plenty of books for the hostel students, and even day scholars can opt for that. The quality of food is good, and there is special treatment for students opting for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good food, strict rules, good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is somewhat average since it is a 30-year-old college, but new buildings being constructed have some good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available only in the hostel and lab; no Wi-Fi is available in classrooms. Labs are good with all the necessary equipment, and hostel food quality is also above average.

reviews.review_heading: The correct route to your future.
reviews.review_text: The college includes a large library with nearly all the books we need, canteens that serve delicious refreshments at a reasonable cost, and smart boards that allow students to learn topics visually. Snacks produced and grown on campus are offered at less money. With the best facilities, students may obtain all they need at this college.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi in all the labs, and each floor has a lab, so the Wi-Fi can reach the classrooms. Still mobile phones are not allowed. There is no canteen inside the college, but there is a stall that sells fries and noodles and a bakery that sells baked goods at very low prices.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for the people who follow rules and study well.
reviews.review_text: The college hostel is clean and neat, and the food is good compared to other colleges. The college has the best lab facilities. Still the mobile data signal is weak in the hostel and on campus.

reviews.review_heading: In our college, food, teaching, and infrastructure are too good.
reviews.review_text: I'm currently in the 1st year. The hostel is good, and the overall infrastructure is very nice. However, many people say our college is one of the strictest in Chennai. They are strict about dress code, lab activities, and speaking in English. The food here is like heaven.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good overall development of student and good placements.

content.Placements: I am still in first semester, first year, but it has been assured that in CS department the placement is almost 100 percent, and the highest package is around 42 LPA for foreign placement and 38 LPA for domestic placement. Placement training is very good according to seniors.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are very neat and well maintained. Same applies to campus and washrooms. Teachers use smart board to interact with class and teach. Library and Labs are very accessible and make everything easy for students. Sports department are very good and facilities are also amazing.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college for both studies and enjoyment. Placements are good, and you can have a good life.

content.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students got placed. The highest package is 33 LPA, and it was a Japanese company. The average package is about 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Infosys, Eurofins, Ancko Visteon, and many others. Roles offered in our courses are electronics engineer, VLSI Engineer, and embedded system engineer.
content.Infrastructure: We have the best infrastructure that any college can provide, 24-hour library facilities, including a digital library. Wi-Fi access for every student. Best labs, most of the labs are developed by recruiting companies, and classrooms are well-equipped with a digital board for every classroom and good ventilation.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Finally, our college is the best for placements. It provides 100% placements.

content.Placements: The average package is 6 LPA, and the maximum packages range from 15-20 LPA and sometimes, above 20 LPA. On the core side, one of the best company that hire students is Capgemini. The percentage of students who got internships from our course is 60%. Companies like SAP, LG, etc., hire students from the college. The top roles offered in our course are chip designer and software developer.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, like a gym, Wi-Fi, library, labs, and classrooms. The maintenance is very high. The food is excellent. Emergency medical facilities are available. The infrastructure and facilities will help thousands of students make an informed college decision.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: NHCE has a good placement percentage, campus life, and industry exposure.

content.Placements: I have just completed my first year, so I do not know much about placement opportunities in the college, but what I have learned from seniors is that the number of students who got placed this year was higher than last year. The highest package is 42.5 LPA, and the lowest package is around 4 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zscalar, Visa, Flexcar, Hitachi, IBM, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte, etc. Nearly 45% of students got internships from my branch in companies like VMware, Société Générale, etc., Top roles offered are full-stack developer, data analyst, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This is an amazing college for students to explore various opportunities.

content.Placements: I am studying computer science with data science. The topmost package for our batch is 25 LPA. Almost 75% of students got an internship offer and are excelling in various companies such as MathCo, Airbus, Nokia, and Rakuten. The top roles given are data analyst and data engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are huge and can accommodate up to 80 to 90 students with smart board facilities and projectors for all uses. The hostel food and the lifestyle are good and well-maintained. They make hygienic food and the all the medical facilities are always available 24 hrs.

reviews_list.review_title: Great Choice IBS Mumbai To Do PGPM.

review_content.Placements: IBS is known for its placement as the best B-school in India. Summer internship programme that we need to do for 8–12 weeks where big firms like JP Morgan, Deloitte, and Morgan Stanley offer internships with salaries up to INR 50,000.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Great Choice IBS Mumbai To Do PGPM.

content.Placements: IBS is known for its placement as the best B-school in India. From the third semester, students are eligible for placements, including the Big Four and companies like Oxane, Digital Marveled, Teach Lip, etc. Many companies hire students, and our alumni work in top companies across the world. If they have any openings, they hire from our college. Our marketing profile offers a salary of 22 Lacs, the highest for our batch. 95% of students get placed, with an average salary of 7 Lacs. Most students secure good jobs after graduation.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is very poor; there is no ground for sports, games, or events. The auditorium is basically a hall with chairs and a dias. Our fest, Konflex, is amazing and includes many dance, singing, and flash mob competitions. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and smart boards. The college does not have any hostels; instead, they allocate rented rooms, but no one took them. Rooms in Powai are expensive, so we stay in Navi Mumbai, where the rent for a 2BHK accommodating 4 students is 20,000.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: IBS college is very good and I would suggest this college to my juniors.

content.Placements: More than 70% students are placed in PGPM course. The highest package offered is 12 Lacs and the lowest package is 7 Lacs. Top recruiting companies are Deloitte, Tata Capital, Wipro, HCL, and Google. More than 80% of the students got internships from PGPM course. Top companies are Aditya Birla Capital, HDFC, L&T, and Propencher. Sales executive and Manager are the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The library has a collection of over 34000 books of Management and other subjects. AC classrooms are available which are working and in a very good condition. You can have coffee in the short time break at Nescafé. The canteen has a lot of variety to eat for lunch. Medical facilities are provided by our college. Indoor games are available in our college including Table tennis, carrom board, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The College has a record of 90% of placements.

content.Placements: Placements are great and the highest package is 15.6LPA. The average is around 7-8LPA and the lowest is 6LPA. TCS, Team Please Bank, Reliance, Google, etc. are some companies that visit the campus. The intake of college is 60 and all 60 students get placement.
content.Infrastructure: They don't have girls hostels facility from college itself but there is one hostel near the college which is good enough to stay until your graduation is over. The rent is around 15000 per month and along with that, you have to deposit 20000 INR for admission which is refundable. Hostel Fee is INR 170000 per year.

faqs.answer: Admissions at IBS Mumbai are done through entrance examinations. Students need to first visit the college's official website and fill out an application form, and pay the application fee. They have to then sit for an either the IBSAT or other national level exams, such as CAT/ GMAT, XAT, NMAT, etc. Applicant are shortlisted for the final selection round on the basis of their performance in the entrance exam. The final round involves a micro-presentation and a PI. Students who clear all rounds should pay the course fee to secure their seat at this college.
faqs.question: How can I get admission at IBS Mumbai?

faqs.answer: The admission process at IBS Mumbai requires a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50%. Entrance exams are mandatory for most courses. Students must first appear for national-level entrances and then move on to university-level selection rounds for final admission. IBS Jaipur offers full-time MBA/PGDM courses for two years and qualify in CAT/IBSAT/NMAT/XAT. It is mandatory for students to qualify the national entrance exam before admission.
faqs.question: How can students join IBS Mumbai?

paragraphs: IBS Mumbai admission procedure begins with the registration process and ends after the final seat allotment. More details on each of the stages of admissions are mentioned below:

For admission to IBS Mumbai by ICFAI Mumbai), candidates who meet the eligibility requirements can apply in either online or offline mode. Candidates applying with an IBSAT score must complete the registration process. All the details must be filled out carefully in the form and as per the official documents. To submit the application carefully, an application fee of INR 1,800 must be paid via credit card/debit card/net banking.

Admission at IBS Mumbai is entrance-based. The candidates are shortlisted based on merit in either IBSAT or GMAT/CAT/ XAT/ NMAT by GMAC. Candidates' performance in the last qualifying examination is also taken into consideration. Furthermore, shortlisted candidates are called for group discussion and personal interview rounds for seat allotment.
After the final result declaration, admission letters are issued to the selected candidates. Such candidates can further confirm their seats by paying the required amount of fee.

courses_data.name: IBS Mumbai PhD Admission 2025
courses_data.description: IBS Mumbai provides full-time PhD programmes in Management with specializations in Marketing, Finance, Operations, and HR, and an independent PhD in Economics. The programmes equip students to become teachers, researchers, and management consultants. Admission is through IBSAT 2025 or recognized national-level examinations, with exemptions for qualifying candidates. Full-time PhD scholars are provided with fellowships, free boarding, and exposure opportunities abroad under the Visiting Scholar Programme.

faqs.question: What is the structure of the PhD programme at IBS Mumbai?
faqs.answer: The four-year PhD programme offered at IBS Mumbai involves five stages. These include courses, research workshops and projects, PhD qualifying examination, progress seminars, thesis proposal, and thesis work. During the first year, eight courses on seminars, interdisciplinary studies, and research methodology are undertaken by students. Ongoing assessment is carried out at each stage to monitor academic development.

faqs.question: What are the prerequisites for enrolling in the PhD programme at IBS Mumbai?
faqs.answer: For the IBS Mumbai PhD program, MBA degree holders can go directly into doctoral courses. Holders of a postgraduate qualification in allied fields need to complete first-year MBA courses as a prerequisite. This is to ensure that all applicants have a solid management foundation prior to embarking on doctoral research. The programme is meant for those who aspire for careers in teaching, research, and consultancy.

faqs.question: Does IBS Mumbai offers research opportunities during the PhD programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, IBS Mumbai offers several research opportunities throughout the PhD programme, which include a 3-month summer research project in the student's field of specialisation. This is guided by a mentor and ends with a research seminar presentation prior to the PhD qualifying exam. The goal is to get research writing skills that can culminate in publication. Students are also linked with senior faculty for teaching and consultancy guidance.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by IBS Mumbai?
faqs.answer: ICFAI Business School conducts ICFAI Business School Aptitude Test (IBSAT) for admission to its Management courses. However, it is not compulsory for selection. Aspirants with a required score in other accepted exams:CAT/GMAT/NMAT by GMAC/XATare also eligible to apply. Moreover, aspirants shall check out the eligibility requirements before applying for the course. Candidates are shortlisted based on accepted exam scores for further selection rounds. Read more on IBS Mumbai admissionshere.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for IBS Mumbai?
faqs.answer: ICFAI Business School (IBS) Mumbai offers a PG programme in the Management stream. To be eligible for the MBA programme, students must have a bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Students' selections are based on IBSAT/CAT/GMAT/NMAT by GMAC/XAT by appearing one of the exam and prepare for Micro Presentation and Personal Interview.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is perfect here, faculty, studies, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent, and there is room for growth, so construction is still going on. Classrooms are so good. Wi-Fi works well, hostel, mess, and everything are good. College canteen and food are perfect, no regret for joining this college as everything is going great.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Amity University Bengaluru till now.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure building is growing consistently compared to others. Right now, the cafeteria is being expanded. The hostel facilities might be a little expensive but quite clean and hygienic. There are medical facility for emergency, medical facility for hostlers, and a gym. We also have a basketball court, a volleyball court, and badminton court beside the gym. It has great greenery across the campus and cricket nets for corkball.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: It has good facilities like a ground, cricket pitch, a badminton court, and many other games. It has good classrooms with AC. All labs a fully furnished. It has a good hostel room for both AC and non-AC. It has a college canteen, hostel mess and a bakery.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty members and good education.
reviews.review_text: The hostel premises are neat and tidy. There is a gym with free membership for students, badminton courts, basketball courts, cricket and football fields as well. There are bus facilities on Sunday to explore Bangalore city for the hostellers. The labs have brand new equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Bengaluru.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. The college has a good ambiance with nice interiors. It provides AC classrooms for everyone. Labs are well-equipped. Hostel is very nearby. It's on the same campus. Day scholars don't have to worry about transport, but they provide transport facility too.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is neat and clean. Discipline is maintained. The mess food is good and hygienic. There is a bakery with good variety of foods. There is a student smart as well to buy all the essentials for students. Xerox and printout facilities are also there. The classes and labs have good quality equipment and furniture.

reviews.review_heading: It has great infrastructure and education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure on the college campus is good. There is AC everywhere. Seats and benches are in good condition. Labs are well-equipped, especially the biotechnology labs with high-quality equipment. The hostel is clean with a warden to maintain discipline. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good opportunities and great campus life.
reviews.review_text: The ambiance is good and the location of the college is very good. The only problem is it's a little far from the city. The college is not developed completely, and a little part of the college is still under development. The hostel is on the same campus as the academic block, which makes it easy to travel for hostelers.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Bengaluru.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are full air conditioned. The library don't have much books but daily we can go and come. The canteen is quite good but sometimes dish is not good. Wi-Fi is speed but you need to register. The food is available in both North and South Indian styles.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and unique experience. See you in Amity.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are average and the infrastructure is perfect. I love the campus it's maintained very neatly and every day. They are cleaned it's full of grass. The place-to-seat hostel facility is okay compared to other colleges and the food is average, not bad.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and campus life.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are good. We are provided with well-equipped classrooms. We have access to Wi-Fi. Library is open and has many books to enhance our knowledge. The food quality in the canteen is also good. We have a sports complex that hosts various games like badminton and cricket. There is also a gym. We have 2 canteens and a bakery. Medical facilities are also given. There is a medical staff present every day.

reviews.review_heading: The hostel and some of the college rules are strict but still it's a nice place to learn and enjoy.
reviews.review_text: The buildings only look good but are really weak. Hosted rules are like 10th grade school ones no kettle and no electrical appliances. They won't even provide food with that much hostel fee. The canteen food is the worst and costly. The Wi-Fi is slow and they will check bags every time and no food is allowed on campus.

reviews.review_heading: A nice college with nice infrastructure and education.
reviews.review_text: I personally feel like the infrastructure of this college is one of the best in Bangalore. The class, benches, podium, projector, AC, centralized AC, a separate building for labs, and a separate floor for computer labs as well as library on each floor are there.

reviews.review_heading: A nice college with good environment.
reviews.review_text: I am not a hosteller and I am a day scholar. But according to what I have heard from my friends, they say it's just okay and not too good. Wi-Fi is not upto the mark. The taste of the food is just fine. Warden comes for regular checkings.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Bengaluru.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is actually very good. AC classrooms are provided for everyone. College has centralized AC everywhere. There is a library on each floor. Staff rooms are also there on every floor. Wi-Fi is poor. Mess, canteen, and bakery are available.

The institutealso accepts national-level entrance exam scores such as JEE Main for admission to its BE/B.Tech courses. Admission is also offered through exams like MHT CET and GATE.If you want to join JSPM through JEE, your safescore should be above 80 percentile. You can get the best branches like AI or Computer engineering after this score.

faqs.question: Can I join JSPM Narhe directly?
faqs.answer: No, there is no direct admission procedure present in JSPM Narhe Technical Campus.For taking admission in this institute you need to give a National Level Entrance Examination like JEE, GATE, MHTCET, GMAT etc. and you are given admission on the basis of your final score in these examinations.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities have air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned options. I had chosen the air-conditioned hostel as it had attached bathrooms. It cost ₹1.6 Lacs rupees per year. The mess food quality was also too good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Since it is an autonomous college, it follows an individual syllabus for teaching, and advanced technology for every phase of the academics. The college activities are done with expertise. Rooms are spacious, first year students have to share the room, but from the 2nd year and above, they are free to decide whether they want to continue or want a separate room. Rooms are plenty, and they have never had any type of shortage. PGs' average rental at my time was Rs. 1,200.

reviews.review_heading: Student review on Shiksha.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course are so good. Wi-Fi, plus two libraries, are all available in my course. The quality and facilities in my hostel are so super, and the food is made so healthy. Medical facilities are available in my course, and games are also present.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSPM’s Narhe Technical Campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are super. Wi-Fi and classrooms are present. A library is available in the college. The food quality in my college is tasty. Medical facilities are available in the college. Sports and games are available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but required to improve the placement percentage.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of my college are good because there are some smart classrooms. In my classroom, there are air-conditioners and a projector. Smart boards are also available. There are specific labs for those specific subjects and there is a VC hall for small programs.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with a short but sweet and green campus.
reviews.review_text: I am a local student who lives in the house with parents, but from my hostel friends, I have heard a lot about the hostels. They are good enough and have plenty of facilities. Classrooms as well as libraries are air-conditioned, and the ambience is well and good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSPM’s Narhe Technical Campus.
reviews.review_text: Girls' hostels are overall good and cleaned daily except Sunday. The boys' hostel is not well-maintained. The mess food in the college is not at all good. A library is available. We have a gym.

reviews.review_heading: JSPM Narhe Institute review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of the college are so good, but the infrastructure is not well. Wi-Fi, labs, and library are available for the students. The quality and facilities in the hostel and canteen are very good, but the food is not good. Medical and sports facilities are available for all students.

reviews.review_heading: Perfectly fine and good college
reviews.review_text: College is well ventilated and Even environment is student friendly which can be easily adapted by the student Wifi facilities are provided technical labs are good classroom are ventilated hostel are good but mess facilitiy is not included water is not continuously available

reviews.review_heading: Holistic education and modern infrastructure at JSPM.
reviews.review_text:
Overall, infrastructure is good. It provides smart classrooms, a software lab, and a hardware lab for practical learning. High internet is there.
A dedicated library with both physical and digital resources. The hostel is well-maintained, with good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Good, exploring campus life.
reviews.review_text: Food quality of college canteen and mess is not so good and healthy. Hostel is quite good and maintained. College has many facilities like auditoriums, libraries, gymnasium, etc. The quality of teaching is very good, weak Wi-Fi connection is provided from college. Also, no AC classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review online for college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in course is very good. Wi-Fi and classroom is too good. Library is not available for student use. Quality of food is very tasty and students like the food. Sports and games are available. Medical facilities are also good in my course.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure is there.
reviews.review_text: There is outstanding infrastructure available, and for each course there is a department and there are labs and classrooms, and the quality of the food was very good, the canteen is good, the medical facilities are okay, and we have good sports and games here.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure needs to be improved.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are good. An elevator is also available. Hostel rooms are good, and Wi-Fi is provided. The quality of food in the canteen is also good. The campus is well-maintained, with every department having its own building. However, there are occasional water problems in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSPM’s Narhe Technical Campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostel does not provide a mess facility. It is separate. At the time of admission, you should book your seat in the hostel. The rooms are cleaned every day and 3 girls have to live in a single room. The room has separate toilets and a bathroom.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admissions at Atria Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking BTech at Atria Institute of Technology must have cleared CET for Karnataka students or COMED-K for all the students. Admission to management quota seats is purely merit-based, and students are eligible from any part of India and abroad. The basic qualifications include class 12 with subjects relevant to BTech, and admission formalities must be completed within the stipulated timeframe.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure for B.Tech programme at Atria Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: The admissions in BTech in the institute, Atria Institute of Technology are done through CET, COMED-K, or management quota. The Karnataka domicile students opt for CET admission from February and seat allotment appears in the month of June. The COMED-K open to both Karnataka and nonKarnataka domiciliary students with the test happening in the month of May whereas management quota-based admissions get lined up based on merit and begin in the month of April and during counseling in the campus.

faqs.question: What is the BTech cutoff for SC and ST categories at AIT?
faqs.answer: AIT BTech cutoff 2023 for Civil Engineering was 67563 for SC and 67563 for ST category. While the admissions are based on the scores/rank obtained in COMEDK, the last cut offs also change a lot depending on All India quota or Home State. It also varies if the applicant is a female.

courses_data.description: AIT MBA/PGDM admission is based on candidates' performance in national/state-level entrance exams, such asMAT, XAT, CAT, CMAT, KCET, KMAT,andKarnataka PGCET. Also, students need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure for MBA programme at Atria Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Admission to the MBA programme at Atria Institute of Technology is through PGCET or management quota. The Karnataka Examinations Authority conducts the PGCET and covers half of the intake. The remaining 50% is under management quota. Candidates with valid scores in PGCET, KMAT, or CMAT can apply through direct visit to the campus to complete all the admission formalities.

faqs.question: Does Atria Institute of Technology accept MAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, AIT in Bengaluru accepts MAT scores and offers an opportunity to students, which covers around 50 per cent management quota admissions in addition to those with MAT, CMAT, or KMAT, while the balance 50% is from those who take Post Graduate Common Entrance Test by the Karnataka Examinations Authority or KEA. A bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) is a must for being eligible.

faqs.question: How to register for COMEDK Counselling?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to BTech course through COMEDK 2024 scores must follow the below-mentioned steps to register for COMEDK Counselling 2024:Step 1: Visit the official website of COMEDK at comedk.org.Step 2: Login to Applicant Login ID using the application number and password.Step 3:  On the next page, click on the 'Counselling Registration' TabStep 4: Verify the mentioned details and pay the registration fee to participate in COMEDK Counselling 2023Step 5: On the successful payment message, close the tab and go back to your application form.Step 6: Click on the ‘Document Upload' Tab and upload all the required documents.Step 7: Frequently check the application form and email to keep a track of the verification status of uploaded document.

paragraphs: Zeal College of Engineering admission process 2025is a multi-stage process. Candidates who want to seek admission in any of the undergraduate or postgraduate programmes must first register on theZeal college websiteand then must appear for the entrance test. Candidates are further required to appear for the counselling process to confirm their seat. Mentioned below is the step wise admission process:
STEP 1: Zeal College Application Process 2025

The first step of Zeal College of Engineering and Research application process is that candidates will first be required to register for fresh admission through theZeal College Pune website: zcoer.in. Candidates must fill all their personal, guardian, educational details and must upload all the necessary documents. The final step of theZCOER application processis to submit the application fees.
STEP 2: Zeal College Selection Criteria 2025

After candidates successfully submit the application form, the next step of Zeal College selection process is that candidates must appear for the entrance examination. For admission in the BE programme, candidates can appear for either MHT CET orJEE- Main. Zeal College admission 2025 for ME programme is through GATE orGPAT. Candidates who want to seek admission in MBA course can appear for either of the following entrance tests namely, MAH MBA CET/ATMA/ XAT/CAT/ CMAT/MAT/ GMAT.
STEP 3: Zeal College Counselling and Seat Allotment

Candidates are further required to apply for the counselling process (CAP counselling in case of admission in the BE programme) conducted by the competent authority by filling out the detailed onlineZeal College application form. On the basis of rank obtained by candidates and on the basis of the preference filled by them in the application form, the competent authority will allot them the institute and programme.Check ZCOER Cutoffs.
