reviews.review_heading: It is an easy-going engineering life.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure and facilities, labs are good, and overall, a good mid-level campus. Very good college, but the downside is that there are limited grounds and sports facilities. Courses are available, and indoor activities are very good. The college also appreciates indoor activities rather than outdoor activities.

reviews.review_heading: Decent academics with a balanced campus life.
reviews.review_text: College has good infrastructure with proper classrooms, library and Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, mess food is average. Sports and medical facilities are available and manageable. The medical facility is good as many insights college has taken upfront action towards medical incidents.

reviews.review_heading: Zeal College of Engineering and Research Pune review
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, have different buildings. Has good ground for sports. The cultural department is good, has a recording room, guitar room, a dance room, a ramp room, etc. Canteen can be better, not so okay. Department-wise buildings and labs are sorted, labs can be better, though. Sometimes PCs are not working.

reviews.review_heading: Basic details about the college at the ground level.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is genuinely good. All kinds of facilities are available on campus. It includes Wi-Fi, labs, and a gym. However, there is no boys’ hostel on campus. Many private PGs and hostels are available nearby. The college also has a canteen, playground, clubs, and extracurricular activities. There are some rumors about this college on the internet, but overall, it is an average college.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, a huge campus, qualified faculty, well-maintained surroundings, etc.
reviews.review_text: It has good facilities like Wi-Fi, clean and tidy classrooms, hallways, washrooms, and labs. There is clean and RO-purified drinking water. Hostels are available for girls on the campus itself, with good security. Time slots are available for entry in the hostel for girls. There is a big canteen with many varieties of food. A mess is also available. There are sports to play, like badminton, basketball, cricket, football, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities but strict college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good, no problem in that very well maintained and clean. Wi-Fi is there. We have reading hall, library, labs, and clean washrooms. Just one thing is that there is no boys hostel. Only girls hostel is there that's the only drawback.

reviews.review_heading: Great start with supportive environment and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus spans a lush, green area (5 acres) and has well-maintained smart classrooms, PC labs, a full computer centre with internet and Wi-Fi, and modern seminar space. The central library is impressively large (922 sqm), housing over 30,000 physical books, thousands of e-books, and access to international journals. There's a girls-only campus hostel with room for 138 students, equipped with Wi-Fi, solar water heaters, CCTV, recreation hall, UPS, and 24X7 security.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good. Don't listen to or take advice about college from any source for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is good and small with big sport ground and lots of sport activities like cricket, football, badminton, volleyball, etc. College canteen is one of the best parts of the college and it is very clean and huge. Also, the food served is very good in taste and worth the money.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced learning experience in computer engineering.
reviews.review_text: The computer labs are well-maintained with high-speed internet and modern systems. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards and comfortable seating. Campus Wi-Fi is available for all students. Students have access to coding platforms and digital libraries. The college has a nice canteen and a big playground.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement, full internship support with frequent backup, and good friendly staff.
reviews.review_text: All good like Wi-Fi, well-equipped modern labs, classrooms with projectors, huge library, playgrounds, etc. Hostel quality is good. Food is also nice. Sports are best at this college, free coaching for each sports, and good facilities. All facilities like sports and gym are free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: My journey at Zeal College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Smart classrooms and well-equipped labs, e.g., computers, electronics, and mechanical, with modern equipment and good internet access. Campus-wide Wi-Fi and a central library with textbooks, journals, and digital resources. In this college, a boys' hostel is not provided, but girls' hostels are also provided. Hostels are clean with 24/7 security, Wi-Fi, and hot water. Mess food is hygienic and decent. The canteen offers affordable snacks and meals. On-campus first aid room and tie-ups with the n...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the good teachers and good placements in 2018.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our department include free Wi Fi computer labs classrooms and libraries. The quality of food in the mess is good and medical facilities are also available. Sports and games such as kabaddi football and cricket are offered, along with indoor games like carrom and chess.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. Students can admission here to make their dreams come true.
reviews.review_text: It is a good college. It has a playground, a basketball court, and a canteen. There are two types of canteens, open canteen and in canteen, so students do not go outside for lunch or breakfast. It has different buildings for different branches and courses.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Zeal College of Engineering and Research.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities and infrastructure, with good mess and canteens. Sports ground and activities such as cricket and football are taken on a daily basis, as there are dedicated teachers and staff members for it. Even there is a gym with a gym trainer.

reviews.review_heading: The vision and mission of our institute are very clear for students.
reviews.review_text: Labs are suitable for students, and the equipment is all available in the labs. The environment of college is very fresh. In classrooms, there is a digital device to teach students. The microphone is used to speak clearly. Hostel building is always neat and clean.
